Below it, indented to the body text's left edge, two shorter quotations follow as replies in the same component at true size, 440px wide, 32px apart. Columns 10–12 stay empty. There is no heading; the first comment is the largest type in the section.\",\n  \"mobile\": \"The large comment fills the width inside 20px margins, body text at 7vw, initials disc 40px. The two replies follow at true size, indented 28px, using the remaining width, 24px apart. Dates and states stay. Nothing is centred.\",\n  \"seenIn\": [\n   \"opl-ohhmydesign\",\n   \"opl-heyclicky\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"cta-first-step-already-open\",\n  \"role\": \"cta\",\n  \"name\": \"First step, already open\",\n  \"shape\": \"split\",\n  \"tags\": [\n   \"ui-led\",\n   \"colour-field\"\n  ],\n  \"directions\": [\n   \"product-performs\",\n   \"colour-chapters\",\n   \"loud-flat-poster\",\n   \"split-stage\",\n   \"dark-room\",\n   \"one-motif\"\n  ],\n  \"needs\": [],\n  \"blueprint\": \"The page ends with the product's first screen already open. A full-bleed field in the accent colour, 90svh tall. Right, in columns 7–11, vertically centred: the product's own create dialog at true size, 440px wide, root marked data-ui, with its real title ('Name your workspace'), one text field holding an editable, believable example, one two-option segmented choice and its primary button. Inside the fragment the product's conventions apply, including the shadow its dialog normally casts. The field accepts typing, the choice switches, and the primary button is the page's only action: it carries the typed value into sign-up. Left, in columns 1–5, anchored to the bottom with 40px margins: the closing line, two to four words at clamp(56px, 7vw, 112px), leading 0.92, on two lines, and under it one sentence at 17px saying what happens after the button. The upper-left stays empty.\",\n  \"mobile\": \"The closing line leads at 13vw on two lines, top-left, with its sentence beneath at 16px. The dialog follows at full width inside 16px margins, at true size, its primary button 52px tall and full width. The field is at least 84svh; the dialog sits in its lower half.\",\n  \"seenIn\": [\n   \"opl-near\",\n   \"opl-midnight-2\"\n  ]\n }\n]",
  "bundled-skills/design-taste-frontend/library/sites.json": "[\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-pp-neue-montreal\",\n  \"name\": \"PP Neue Montreal\",\n  \"url\": \"https://neuemontreal.com/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"other\",\n  \"score\": 8.6,\n  \"idea\": \"A typeface specimen dressed as a vintage city travel guide: the font named after Montreal is sold through guidebook titling, postcards and old tourist footage.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"bold\",\n   \"playful\",\n   \"retro-modernist\",\n   \"typographic\",\n   \"confident\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"giant-wordmark\",\n  \"hero\": \"Grainy coral-red field. Top row: a monogram in a pale pill at left, a pale-grey pill nav with seven links centred, a black pill button at right. Below at the left margin, a two-line white bold title at about 4.5vw; opposite it, a ring of repeated monograms set around a circle like a stamp. Three full-width black hairlines cut the field into bands: a two-line intro sentence at ~1.6vw sits in the second, and the typeface name fills the third in black bold at ~17vw, two lines, tight leading, 60% of the width. A 4:3 clip of 1960s street footage is inset bottom-right, 29% wide, bottom-aligned with the name.\",\n  \"type\": \"PP Neue Montreal only: Bold for display with -0.01em tracking and leading near 0.9, Text Regular 16px for body and lists. Sizes leap from 16px to 144px headings to a ~240px name; one section enlarges a single lowercase letter to viewport height.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#ed4b44 #1a1a1a #f0e7d4 #18bc42 #b5b5b5 #f2c21a — Each chapter takes a flat field (coral red, near-black, cream, green) with black or cream type; one headline colours every word differently. Warm, print-poster feel with visible grain.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Archive 1960s city footage, saturated vintage postcards, a handwritten postcard back, and rotated specimen posters and stamp sheets scattered around a headline. All square-cornered and inset, never full-bleed.\",\n  \"layout\": \"24px side margins and full-width hairlines marking bands. Content is left-anchored in three or four columns split by vertical hairlines; chapters alternate between tabular lists, a scattered collage, a centred statement and a giant glyph comparison. A pill nav stays pinned.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"Near-black screen split by a vertical hairline at about 75% width. Left: a three-line small heading at the top margin, then a five-line bold oblique headline at ~6vw in which each line is indented further right like a staircase and each word takes its own colour (green, cream, grey, yellow, blue, orange). Right narrow column: two stacked postcards, one saturated photo card and one cream handwritten card with a stamp. A tiny section label sits bottom-left.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"A dark band of pure tabular type. A body paragraph occupies column one; weight names stack as tight single-line lists in two further columns divided by vertical hairlines. Below, a small label over a full-width rule introduces a two-column timeline: years stacked at the left margin, release notes stacked from the centre line behind a short vertical rule. One text size, leading near 1.0, no decoration at all.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"gallery\",\n    \"description\": \"Dark full-viewport stage with a three-line cream headline at ~4vw placed dead centre. Around it eight or nine specimen artefacts (a stamp sheet, a green poster with a blue numeral, a grey flag chart, a rainbow ticket grid, concentric colour squares) are each rotated 10 to 30 degrees and arranged on a loose ring, several cropped by the viewport edge, as if tossed on a table.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"showcase\",\n    \"description\": \"Cream field. A caption row at the top: a two-line label at the left margin and a five-line paragraph starting at about 55% width. Then a full-width rule carrying a tiny label at each end naming the two cuts. Below it, two black lowercase letters, each roughly half the viewport wide and cropped by the bottom edge, one from each cut, so the reader compares shapes at poster scale.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Give a product page a borrowed genre (here a tourist guidebook) and let that genre dictate titles, imagery and chapter names.\",\n   \"Cut a flat colour hero into bands with full-width hairlines and set the name at ~17vw in the bottom band beside a small inset film clip.\",\n   \"Scatter rotated print artefacts on a loose ring around a centred headline and let several crop off the viewport.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-seasats\",\n  \"name\": \"Seasats\",\n  \"url\": \"https://www.seasats.com/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"physical-product\",\n  \"score\": 8.4,\n  \"idea\": \"Calm, dusk-lit seascapes sell autonomous boats as serene instruments, and the navigation is a column of stacked colour swatches taken from that sea-and-sand palette.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"serene\",\n   \"cinematic\",\n   \"engineered\",\n   \"assured\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"fullbleed-media-overlay\",\n  \"hero\": \"A 10px white frame surrounds everything. The left 84% is one rounded media panel: a dusk scene of a low, solar-decked vessel centred on mirror-flat water, with two larger hulls cropped by the panel's left and right edges. The headline is centred in the panel's upper third, two lines of white light-weight flared serif at 124px (8.6vw). A wordmark in custom wide techno lettering sits top-left; a white rounded button with mono caps and a dark-green square arrow sits bottom-centre. The right 14% is the menu: a full-height column of stacked flat colour blocks (blush, sage, then four darkening olives), each holding left-aligned 15px links, sub-items numbered 01 to 04.\",\n  \"type\": \"seasonMix, a low-contrast serif-sans hybrid, light weight, sentence case, near-zero tracking, at 124px for the headline and about 40px for statements; seasonSans 16px for body and menu; supplyMono uppercase at 9 to 12px for buttons, tags and footer data.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#a6b3bc #232323 #b7c8be #d6c4b8 #2c3620 #e2832a — Slate blues and lilac greys from the seascapes dominate; the menu adds blush, sage and olive blocks; the footer flips to a burnt-orange and rust scene. Text stays white.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Photoreal rendered footage of autonomous boats on glassy water at dusk: symmetrical, low horizon, lots of sky, full-bleed after the hero. Small square-cornered inset stills with mono tag labels float over the scene.\",\n  \"layout\": \"Mostly full-viewport scenes with one centred text block each, at top or bottom, and the wordmark fixed top-left. Only the hero uses the framed panel-plus-menu split. A thin vertical progress line runs down the right edge.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"features\",\n    \"description\": \"A pinned full-bleed scene shot from the boat's deck: the hull forms a dark symmetrical wedge rising from the bottom edge to a mast at centre, horizon at one-third. At top-centre six short statements are stacked, centred, at 16px; one is white and the others half opacity, and the highlight steps down the list on scroll. For each, small photo cards (150 to 220px wide, square corners, mono tag on the top edge) appear left and right of the mast.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"A full-bleed aerial view of dark teal water with several small vessels scattered across the lower half and a faint horizon near the top. A single two-line statement in the light serif at about 40px sits centred near the bottom edge. Nothing else is on screen except the wordmark top-left and the thin progress line at right.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"Colour inverts to a burnt-orange haze over rust-red terrain, with black silhouettes of hulls and a keel hanging from the top edge as if seen from below the surface. Mid-height: mono readouts at left reporting distance scrolled in metres and scroll speed in knots with a one-line quip; a link list at 16px in the centre; mono contact details at right. The wordmark fills the full width at the bottom, white, about 130px tall.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Build the menu as a full-height column of stacked flat colour blocks sampled from the imagery, grouping links by block colour instead of by rules or headings.\",\n   \"List every claim at once, centred and dimmed, and move a single full-opacity highlight through the list on scroll while supporting images appear around a fixed subject.\",\n   \"Give the footer its own opposite-temperature scene and a live readout of how far and how fast the visitor scrolled, in the product's own units.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-ai-in-design-report-2026\",\n  \"name\": \"Ai in Design Report 2026\",\n  \"url\": \"https://stateofaidesign.com/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"other\",\n  \"score\": 8.4,\n  \"idea\": \"A research report laid out like a colour-blocked print annual: a thermal-blurred video collage on top, an oversized tight grotesk title, and flat orange, lilac, sage and black blocks carrying stats, quotes and chapters.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"editorial\",\n   \"bold\",\n   \"colour-blocked\",\n   \"assured\",\n   \"contemporary\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"editorial-masthead\",\n  \"hero\": \"The top 53% is a full-width video band: blurred, heat-map-like abstract footage in orange, lilac and sage, overlaid with four or five hard-edged rectangles of the same footage in grey or green, two tagged with tiny mono labels in white boxes. The header sits flush on top: a black logo block at far left, an orange link tab running to 40% of the width, two plain links at right. Below the band, on white: a two-line deck at about 1.4vw on a 1% left margin, and from 42% across a two-line title at 8.3vw, medium weight, tracking -0.06em. Bottom row: mono credit left, scroll cue and arrow aligned to the title column.\",\n  \"type\": \"Beausite Classic, a grotesk with some stroke contrast, in Medium for titles and Regular for text; sentence case, tracking -0.06em at display size. Geist Mono for small uppercase labels. Steps: 8.3vw title, about 5.5vw numerals, about 3vw statements, 16px body, 10px mono. Footer wordmark near 96vw.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#ffffff #000000 #fe7141 #cdabfe #d1ddd3 #f0ff1c — White base with flat blocks of orange, lilac, sage and black assigned to whole modules (stat tiles, quote panels, chapter bands), all drawn from the hero footage. Text is black, or off-white on black.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Hero: abstract blurred video with a heat-map grade, cut into overlapping rectangles. Body: warm documentary photos and clips of people at desks in wood-lined rooms, square-cornered, butted directly against flat colour blocks with no gap.\",\n  \"layout\": \"1% margins and a recurring column line at about 42% where most headings and text begin. Open white text passages ruled by hairlines alternate with tight mosaics in which photos and colour blocks share edges. Each chapter opens with a full-width colour band.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"proof\",\n    \"description\": \"A full-width hairline, a tiny mono label at the left, then seven black partner logos evenly spaced across the full width in one row with generous padding above and below, closed by a second hairline. Immediately beneath, another mono label and a three-line statement at about 3vw, flush left and occupying only the left half, followed by a full-width photo strip.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"stats\",\n    \"description\": \"A mosaic with no gutters. A photo of two people at a laptop fills the left two-thirds at roughly 1:1; the right third is split into two stacked flat tiles, lilac above and sage below. Each tile carries a large numeral with a plus sign at about 5.5vw in its top-left corner and a two-line caption directly beneath; the rest of the tile is empty colour.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"testimonial\",\n    \"description\": \"Quote module as two abutting blocks: a black block on the left 40% holding only a small name and a mono role caption, and a sage block on the right 60% with the quotation at about 3vw, top-left aligned with empty sage beneath. Directly below, a full-width orange band opens a chapter: hairline at top, a large two-digit number with the chapter word under it at left, a two-line title and small paragraph starting at the 42% column.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"Black footer. A row of three small source counts along the top, separated by vertical hairlines, then the report name in off-white heavy type at nearly full viewport width with a trademark sign at its top-right, then the year at the same size right-aligned on a second line. Two small link columns with mono headings sit lower left beside the year; a hairline and one row of credits and partner logos close it.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Start most headings and text at a fixed column line about 42% across, leaving the left for small decks, credits and chapter numbers.\",\n   \"Butt flat colour tiles directly against a photograph with no gutter and put one large numeral plus two caption lines in each tile's top-left corner.\",\n   \"Take the page's flat block colours from the hero footage so the abstract video and the layout read as one palette.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-house-of-honey-1\",\n  \"name\": \"House of Honey\",\n  \"url\": \"https://www.houseofhoney.com/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"studio-portfolio\",\n  \"score\": 8.4,\n  \"idea\": \"A block-heavy wordmark pierced by a hairline script: the bold-against-delicate contrast is repeated at every scale, with giant pink script behind quiet serif statements.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"glamorous\",\n   \"warm\",\n   \"playful\",\n   \"editorial\",\n   \"confident\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"giant-wordmark\",\n  \"hero\": \"Top 42% is a flat blush-pink band; the bottom 58% is a full-bleed photograph of a bright living room, arched window on the centre axis, butting against the band with no margin. A tiny nav row sits at the very top with 8px side margins: block logo glyph and five links left, contact link with a small square arrow box far right. The wordmark fills the width edge to edge: two words in ultra-black extended caps, about 120px cap height, dark aubergine, with a hairline script 'of' 230px tall between them, overshooting above and below. Directly beneath, two two-line serif uppercase taglines at 31px, one flush left, one flush right.\",\n  \"type\": \"Wordmark in ultra-black extended caps; statements in noeText serif, uppercase, 31–40px, tight tracking; nav and captions in neueHaasGrotesk around 14px; 'canora' hairline script for the connecting word and for cropped background words at 37vw. Three contrasting voices, each with one job.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#edccbe #331917 #0e0e0e #f26fcb #ffffff — Blush pink and dark aubergine-brown alternate as full fields and as each other's text colour. Hot pink appears only in the oversized script and a 2px divider. Photographs bring saturated colour.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Editorial interior photography, saturated and daylight-lit. Hero is a full-bleed landscape crop; projects are portrait crops about 5:6 in a three-column grid with 4px gutters and square corners.\",\n  \"layout\": \"Edge-to-edge with 8px outer margins. Typographic sections (small centred label, serif statement, cropped giant script) alternate with a three-column image grid. Blush and brown fields swap each section; hairline link rows close blocks. The footer is a full-width logo glyph.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"Dark aubergine field under the hero photo, separated by a 2px hot-pink line. A small sans label centred, then a three-line centred serif uppercase statement at about 31px in blush, 45% of the width. Behind it a hot-pink script phrase set near 37vw runs off both sides and is cut by the section's bottom edge, its ascenders rising into the statement. A smaller serif line follows.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"Title card before the project grid. Blush field, nearly empty screen. A small label and a one-line serif uppercase heading about 40px sit centred at 55% height. The giant pink script returns, cropped by the bottom edge so only its top half shows and running off both sides.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"work\",\n    \"description\": \"Three columns edge to edge with 4px gutters and 8px outer margins. Portrait photos about 500×580px, square corners. Under each: an uppercase sans title at 14px and a grey line of GPS coordinates. Two rows, then a full-width hairline row with a text link left and a small square arrow box at the far right.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"Brown field. The logo glyph is enlarged to full width and about a third of the screen: blush rectangles and quarter-circle arcs with 4px gaps, forming an abstract monogram. Below: four columns of small links, a hairline, two addresses in the first two columns, another hairline, then copyright left and a small blush button right.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Set a wordmark edge to edge in ultra-heavy extended caps and thread a hairline script connecting word through it that overshoots the cap height both ways.\",\n   \"Use an oversized script word in one hot accent colour as a cropped background layer behind small, calm serif statements.\",\n   \"Split a tagline into two halves, flush left and flush right on the same baseline under the wordmark, instead of centring it.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-white-desert\",\n  \"name\": \"White Desert\",\n  \"url\": \"https://white-desert.com/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"hospitality\",\n  \"score\": 8.4,\n  \"idea\": \"One word, the destination, set a third of the screen tall over footage like a film title card; sheer scale stands in for remoteness.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"cinematic\",\n   \"epic\",\n   \"luxurious\",\n   \"cold\",\n   \"restrained\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"bottom-anchored-type\",\n  \"hero\": \"Full-bleed video (the view from an aircraft window over an ice shelf, darkly vignetted by the window frame) fills the viewport. Faint vertical hairlines divide it into six columns. Top-left, three outlined rectangular nav buttons about 120 by 40px with 6px gaps; top-right, two more; between them a small white mountain logo over a condensed caps name. One condensed uppercase word spans almost the full width at 17.8vw, white, centred, anchored so its baseline sits about 35px above the bottom edge. At mid-height a two-line italic serif tagline at about 16px hangs on the first column line at left, and a film-play label sits between two hairlines at right.\",\n  \"type\": \"Three voices: Oswald 400 uppercase for the giant word and footer wordmark (up to 22vw); Cardinal Classic Long, a light high-contrast serif, for caps statements near 32px and italic taglines; Inter Tight 14px for nav and body. Body to display is roughly an 18x jump.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#040608 #ffffff #e9e7e1 #1f2b4d #f5821f #95979a — Footage and near-black open the page; content sections flip to pure white with navy serif type and end on a warm grey footer. One small orange tab is the only accent. Cool overall.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Aerial and wildlife footage and stills of ice, penguins and rust-coloured rock peaks, natural cool grade, always full-bleed with square corners; trips appear as tall vertical image slices set side by side with no gaps.\",\n  \"layout\": \"A six-column grid made visible by faint full-height hairlines runs through every section. Text blocks are small and hung off column lines, often starting at column two or three, with large voids around them. Full-bleed image screens alternate with nearly empty white text screens.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"A white screen with the six vertical hairlines still showing. A serif caps paragraph at about 32px, navy, light weight and tight leading, occupies only columns two to four, left-aligned with its first line indented by half the measure. Above its top-left sits a small italic label ringed by a loose hand-drawn pen scribble. An orange vertical tab with rotated text is fixed to the right edge.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"gallery\",\n    \"description\": \"Leaving the hero, the giant word blurs and dissolves into white mist that becomes the next section's background. Later a full-viewport photograph of jagged rock peaks in snow bleeds to all four edges, with a narrow 13px paragraph from the white section above overlapping its top edge at a column line, so text and image interlock rather than stack.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"showcase\",\n    \"description\": \"A serif caps heading at about 40px sits left of centre with a long pencil-like scribble underline that extends well past the words on both sides. Below, a full-width band of four vertical image panels with no gaps and unequal widths, like an accordion; the first panel carries a two-line italic serif title in white at its top-left.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"Warm grey field. The top row holds a small logo, three columns of grey link lists with italic serif group headings and, at right, a stack of square-cornered off-white tiles (a video thumbnail, two half-width buttons, one full-width). Beneath, the brand name in navy condensed caps runs edge to edge at about 22vw. A final strip has award badges left, a centred italic quotation and legal links right.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Set a single place name in condensed caps at about 18vw, centred and anchored to the bottom edge of full-bleed footage, with everything else on screen at 14-16px.\",\n   \"Leave the column grid visible as faint full-height hairlines across video, white and footer sections, and hang small text blocks off those lines.\",\n   \"Ring or underline small serif labels with a loose hand-drawn pen scribble to put one human mark into an otherwise strict layout.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-applied-imagination\",\n  \"name\": \"Applied Imagination\",\n  \"url\": \"https://applied-imagination.gpc.consulting\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"other\",\n  \"score\": 8.3,\n  \"idea\": \"An essay conceived on a flight is read as a descent: an altimeter ticks from 30,000 ft to zero while you scroll down through halftone clouds to mountains at ground level.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"airy\",\n   \"witty\",\n   \"editorial\",\n   \"dreamlike\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"type-poster\",\n  \"hero\": \"A pale blue sky fading to warm cream fills the viewport, with white clouds shaded in halftone dots. A tiny serif logotype sits top-centre; no nav. The title, two centred lines of black wedge-serif at 8.9vw, occupies the middle half of the screen and about 73% of its width; a cloud layer passes in front of the second line's baseline so the feet of the letters dissolve into dots. A two-line centred deck at 24px sits beneath. A mono byline strip is centred on the bottom edge with a scroll cue bottom-right. On the left edge at mid-height, a short vertical rule carries a two-line mono altitude readout.\",\n  \"type\": \"fsKim, a sturdy wedge-serif display face, regular weight at 128px with -0.01em tracking for the title and pull quotes; gtAmerica at 24px for the deck and about 16px for essay body; gtAmericaMono uppercase around 11px with wide tracking for byline, altitude and tape labels.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#cbe4f2 #f1e3b5 #0a0a0a #ffc013 #8e2f8f #f04e23 — Sky blue melting into sand yellow is the constant ground and text is black. Saturated magenta, orange and yellow arrive only in collage objects, tape labels and the footer contact card.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Photo-collage cut-outs (parachutes carrying a treasure chest and a burning dumpster, a pair of legs, mountains) given a coarse halftone dot screen, layered in front of and behind the type against painted clouds.\",\n  \"layout\": \"A narrow text column about 38% wide for essay passages, interrupted by full-width display pull quotes and collage objects floating at the edges. One continuous sky instead of sections, with a fixed left-edge altimeter. Nearly 23 screens, ending on a ground-level landscape.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"Sky background, no container. A three-line pull quote in black wedge-serif at about 7vw is centred and tightly leaded. Two cut-out parachutes hang over it: a magenta one from the top-left carrying a chest spilling coins, an orange one at lower right carrying a burning dumpster, each overlapping letterforms. Small mono labels on tilted strips of coloured tape are stuck to the objects. Words in the quote turn from grey to black as they are reached.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"Running essay text in about 16px grotesk, black, in a single column roughly 38% of the viewport wide, positioned left of centre with large sky margins on both sides. Paragraphs are separated by a blank line; serif sub-statements at about 28px introduce passages. The next display quote is seen rising from below, its letters partly hidden behind cloud and blurred.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"contact\",\n    \"description\": \"Ground level: halftone-screened mountains in green and brown rise from both sides, and the title returns at huge scale, cropped by the top edge and tucked behind the peaks. Centred below is a square-cornered two-panel card: a cream left panel with a short form of two fields and a small orange button, and a magenta right panel with a round portrait, name and a yellow subscribe button. Yellow tape-strip credits sit on the bottom edge.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Tie a persistent numeric readout to scroll position (altitude falling to zero) so the reader's progress becomes part of the story.\",\n   \"Layer an illustration element in front of the bottom of a giant title so the letters sink into the scene instead of sitting on top.\",\n   \"Apply one coarse halftone dot screen to every photo cut-out so collage pieces from different sources read as one illustration set.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-compile\",\n  \"name\": \"Cursor Compile\",\n  \"url\": \"https://cursor.com/compile\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"event\",\n  \"score\": 8.3,\n  \"idea\": \"The event name drawn as seven looping one-line curves in seven colours, more signature than logotype, on an otherwise whisper-quiet off-white page whose images are re-rendered as rows of coloured characters.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"quiet\",\n   \"hand-drawn\",\n   \"warm\",\n   \"technical\",\n   \"restrained\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"giant-wordmark\",\n  \"hero\": \"Warm off-white field with no header or navigation. Starting about 23% down, a line-drawn wordmark spans from 8% to 92% of the width and about 29% of the height: each letter is a single 2px stroke looping like a Lissajous figure, each in a different colour (orange, green, olive, lilac, black, brown, blue), overlapping its neighbours. Directly beneath, two 14px captions, one flush left in ink and one flush right in grey. After a gap of about 20% of the viewport, three equal columns sit at the bottom, each topped by a hairline: an 18px statement, a grey 14px paragraph, and an email field over a full-width near-black rectangular button.\",\n  \"type\": \"The only large lettering is the drawn wordmark. All real text is CursorGothic regular in two sizes, 18px and 14px (the largest text on the page is 1.8vw), sentence case, with hierarchy made by ink versus mid-grey rather than by size or weight.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#edece8 #26251e #f07a1f #2e9e3a #2f6bf0 #9b8ff0 — Warm paper ground with near-black and grey text. The wordmark's colours return one at a time as the single ink of each character-rendered image (lilac, teal, green, orange). Event photos are dark and warm.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Two kinds: landmarks and speaker portraits redrawn as rows of tiny characters in one saturated colour on a tint of the same colour; and dark, warm documentary event photos. All are square-cornered rectangles in strict rows.\",\n  \"layout\": \"About 7% side margins on a three-column grid. Each section has a small two-line heading at left (title in ink, subtitle in grey), then a row or carousel of equal tiles with one-line captions beneath. Very large vertical gaps between sections; a denser photo grid near the end.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"list\",\n    \"description\": \"Tour dates as a three-column grid of 3:2 tiles. Each tile is a city landmark rendered entirely in rows of small characters in one colour on a pale tint of that colour: lilac, teal, green, orange. Under each tile, one caption line: city name in ink, date in grey straight after it, and a status word flush right. A fourth tile wraps alone to the left of a second row, leaving two columns empty.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"gallery\",\n    \"description\": \"Session recordings as stacked carousels. A small heading and grey subtitle, then per stage a tiny label at left with two arrow glyphs at far right and a row of 16:9 dark photo tiles, two full tiles visible and a third cropped by the margin. Each tile has a small white event tag in its bottom-left corner. Caption beneath: speaker name in ink followed by the talk title in grey on the same line.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"about\",\n    \"description\": \"Speaker row: one-line heading at left, arrows at right, then four near-square portrait tiles with 8px gaps, each a face drawn in horizontal rows of characters in one colour on its tint (orange, green, lilac, teal). Some tiles show only plain stripes with the face barely emerging, so portraits appear to resolve from lines as they load or on hover.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"cta\",\n    \"description\": \"After a three-column photo grid with mixed landscape and portrait crops and 8px gaps, the page ends on an empty off-white screen holding one centred sentence at 18px and a small dark pill button beneath it. There are no footer columns, links or legal rows.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Draw the name as one continuous thin looping stroke per letter, each in a different colour, and let it be the only large element on the page.\",\n   \"Keep all text at two small sizes and build hierarchy from ink versus grey on the same line (name in ink, detail in grey right after it).\",\n   \"Re-render photographs as rows of tiny characters in a single saturated colour on a tint of that colour, one colour per tile.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-the-new-industrials\",\n  \"name\": \"The New Industrials\",\n  \"url\": \"https://thenewindustrials.com/\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"other\",\n  \"score\": 8.3,\n  \"idea\": \"A long-read essay laid out inside a visible drafting grid, where colour fields shift as you read and 3D machine parts drift through the margins and finally assemble into the publisher's initials.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"bold\",\n   \"playful\",\n   \"editorial\",\n   \"engineered\",\n   \"saturated\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"editorial-masthead\",\n  \"hero\": \"A saturated orange page framed by black hairlines 24px from each edge. Top strip: a monogram logo left, a black pill with orange monospaced title centred, a boxed year right. Under it a row of eight empty outlined cells, 62px tall, like a ruler. A cream panel then fills the remaining width and height. Inside, a WebGL scene of pastel low-poly machine parts with visible wireframes sits behind a two-line uppercase title in a tall condensed slab serif, glyphs about 210px high, spanning 83% of the width. Small monospaced uppercase credits flank it at mid-height; reading time is centred below, with two boxed share links on the bottom edge.\",\n  \"type\": \"Title in a tall condensed slab serif at roughly 14vw cap height, black, uppercase. Essay in Albra Book serif: 34px lead paragraph, 18px running text with generous leading. Supply Mono in tiny uppercase for credits and box labels; a narrow typewriter-like face for the pull quote.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#ff8126 #f1ead8 #161615 #4db3ff #c5f53d #ff5fc0 — The page background changes as you read: orange, then a gradient through lilac into sky blue, then acid lime at the end. Type and hairlines stay black; the 3D parts carry rainbow gradients.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Real-time 3D machine components (cylinders, gears, polyhedra) in matte pastel with coloured wireframe edges and neon gradient caps; they overlap the title, float into text margins and form letters in the footer.\",\n  \"layout\": \"Black hairlines divide the whole page into cells: one wide text cell flanked by narrow empty ones, each chapter tagged with a small numbered box at its corner. The lead paragraph spans the cell, running text is indented into a narrower column, and full-width quote screens interrupt.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"On orange, a ruled cell with a small numbered square at its top-right corner. The opening paragraph is set in serif at about 34px, seven lines, filling the cell with 60px padding. A horizontal hairline closes the cell; the next one indents its text by about 180px and drops to 18px, with a vertical rule marking the indent. The side cells stay empty, so the grid reads as margin furniture.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"Pull quote: a full-viewport interruption where the grid lines stop. The background becomes a vertical gradient from orange through dusty lilac to sky blue. Centred, five lines of a narrow, widely tracked typewriter-style face at about 48px in dark olive-brown, each letter trailing a soft red vertical smear downward like wet ink. The next cell resumes on the blue that the gradient ended on.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"Body screens: a single serif column about 960px wide between two vertical hairlines, paragraphs separated by a blank line. One 3D object per screen (a grey-green polyhedron with green edges, an orange hexagonal nut) sits half outside the column, crossing the vertical rule and the page edge at a different height each time, so every screen of text has one sculptural interruption.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"Acid-lime field. The publisher's three initials are built as a sculpture from the 3D parts seen earlier, about 60% of the viewport tall and spanning nearly the full width, each letter a different assembly of pipes, gears and blocks in clashing gradients. Below, hairlines form two cells holding monospaced uppercase credits at 10px, aligned to the cells' left padding.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Draw the layout grid as visible black hairlines, including a row of empty cells, and tag each text block with a small numbered box.\",\n   \"Change the page background colour between chapters of a long read so progress is felt as a shift of colour.\",\n   \"Let one family of 3D objects recur at three scales: behind the title, in the margins, and assembled into a monogram at the end.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-wild-as\",\n  \"name\": \"wild\",\n  \"url\": \"https://craft.wild.as\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"agency\",\n  \"score\": 8.3,\n  \"idea\": \"A studio essay on craft versus AI in which everything decorative is drawn on one square-pixel grid: the hero heatmap, the icons, the diagrams, the marquee lettering and the footer equaliser.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"precise\",\n   \"playful\",\n   \"technical\",\n   \"bright\",\n   \"editorial\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"editorial-masthead\",\n  \"hero\": \"White page with a barely visible graph-paper grid. The top 22% is a masthead band split by a vertical hairline at 60%: at left, a two-line uppercase headline in a light grotesk at 5.2vw, tight leading, starting 9% from the left and nearly touching the top edge; at right, a two-line uppercase tagline with words spread to justify the column, then a pixel logo and a small right-aligned description. Below, a full-bleed canvas about 45% of the viewport tall: thousands of small squares in yellow, red, lime, cobalt and navy form a heatmap that erodes into white along its lower edge. A 3vw intro paragraph begins at the fold.\",\n  \"type\": \"Sneak in one regular-to-light weight does everything: uppercase 75px headline at -0.035em, a 44px sentence-case intro, section headings near 30px, 13px body. No bold anywhere.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#ffffff #0a0a0a #f2b90f #3b55d9 #1e2340 #e8452c — White page, black type, black buttons. Colour lives only inside the pixel graphics, in a fixed set of yellow, cobalt, navy, red and lime, so every illustration looks related. No section changes background.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Canvas-drawn square-pixel fields: a heatmap band, particle streams that tighten from scattered dots into a dense ribbon, pixel smiley faces, an equaliser strip. A small fixed mono link sits top-right; the ending is centred.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"work\",\n    \"description\": \"Three equal cards in one row, each a 6:5 image with square corners (laptop mock-up, product photo, flat illustration) followed by a centred project name at about 20px and a centred two-line description in small text. No borders, shadows or tags; a small round black arrow button overlaps the right edge of the third image to advance the row. Large white space above and below.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"Essay rows: a two- or three-line heading at about 2.2vw in the left third with a tiny wide-tracked mono caption below it; in the right two-thirds, two short justified paragraphs at 13px. Under one row, two pixel-art faces built from black squares (a smile and a frown, about 30px) sit side by side, each over a mono label and a three-line centred caption, forming a two-column comparison.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"how-it-works\",\n    \"description\": \"A four-word heading on two lines and a short paragraph at the left, then a wide canvas diagram: scattered pale-blue and navy squares at the left converge into a tight horizontal ribbon in the middle and fan out again in yellow at the right, a pixel funnel. Below it four narrow columns, each with a small round dark marker, a bold one-word label and two lines of small text.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"cta\",\n    \"description\": \"A single line of bitmap lettering scrolls across the full width, each glyph assembled from yellow squares flecked with red, navy and lime. Centred beneath: a black button with stepped pixel corners, two short grey centred paragraphs and an email line. The page ends with a full-width strip of coloured pixel bars like an audio equaliser, a small black play button centred above it.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Pick one drawing primitive, a square on a fixed grid, and render every non-text element with it (hero art, icons, diagrams, display lettering, footer) in one five-colour set.\",\n   \"Split a masthead band 60/40 with a vertical hairline: oversized light-weight uppercase headline at left, a word-spaced justified tagline and tiny descriptor at right.\",\n   \"Lay out long copy as rows with the heading in the left third and body in the right two-thirds, and put the tiny mono caption under each heading instead of an eyebrow above it.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-hilden-kaira\",\n  \"name\": \"Hildén & Kaira\",\n  \"url\": \"https://www.hildenkaira.fi/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"agency\",\n  \"score\": 8.3,\n  \"idea\": \"The agency name is cast in liquid chrome across the full width, and the same chrome becomes emoji that float through the page, tying a social-media pitch to one material.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"brash\",\n   \"glossy\",\n   \"editorial\",\n   \"witty\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"giant-wordmark\",\n  \"hero\": \"Warm light-grey field. A tilted portrait video roughly 180 by 220px covers two of its letters. Directly under the wordmark, four small nav links centred. Then 300px of nothing, with one chrome flame emoji floating at the far left. The headline sits in the bottom third: three centred lines of narrow display serif at 4.4vw, leading so tight that descenders touch ascenders, a two-line 15px sans sub, and two square-cornered buttons, black and pale lime.\",\n  \"type\": \"PP Editorial New 400 for headlines at 63px, -0.02em tracking and leading near 0.9; PP Neue Montreal 13px for nav, body and buttons. The jump is roughly 5:1 with nothing in between. Chrome silver recurs as a material.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Chrome 3D-rendered lettering and emoji objects (flame, heart, dove, microphone, wink) floating free; vertical phone videos of client content shown as fanned, slightly rotated stacks with white borders. Two small testimonials are pushed to the bottom-left and bottom-right corners: five tiny stars, two lines of 11px sans, name and title, each centred in its own narrow block. The centre bottom is left empty.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"work\",\n    \"description\": \"Horizontal carousel of wide white slabs on the grey ground, the next slide peeking at the right edge. Right half: a grey panel with three vertical videos fanned like playing cards.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"features\",\n    \"description\": \"On black, a centred serif section title, then service cards that pin and stack: a lime slab about 55% wide with serif title top-left, grey serif index number top-right, a small paragraph and black button bottom-left and a vertical video inset bottom-right. Then one marquee line at 12vw (173px) in off-white grotesk, cropped at both edges, words separated by a solid dot, closed by a second hairline. Dead centre: a chrome 3D ring token about 400px wide. Bottom-left: a 216×144px royal-blue rounded thumbnail with a two-line mono caption. Bottom-right: a four-line mono uppercase paragraph 450px wide.\",\n  \"type\": \"A semi-condensed grotesk (digest name 'SemiSqueezed') at regular weight carries the 173px marquee, 28px paragraphs and 5vw statements; an uppercase monospace at 11–17px handles tags, captions and link rows. Underneath, a mono address block sits in the rail, and two columns of hairline link rows with corner arrows fill the content area.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Apply one global post-effect (scanlines plus a rounded vignette) over the whole viewport so photos, UI mocks and type all belong to the same screen.\",\n   \"Run the headline as a single cropped marquee line boxed between two hairlines under the nav, leaving the rest of the hero for one object.\",\n   \"Keep a narrow left rail for a mono section tag and a small pinned thumbnail that swaps per section, with copy confined to the right 60%.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-illoca\",\n  \"name\": \"Illoca\",\n  \"url\": \"https://illoca.unseen.co/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"saas\",\n  \"score\": 8.2,\n  \"idea\": \"Software for architects sold as a drafting table: a two-colour illustrated studio on graph paper that the scroll camera pushes into until the drawing fills the screen.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"drafted\",\n   \"calm\",\n   \"analogue\",\n   \"confident\",\n   \"graphic\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"centred-statement-media-below\",\n  \"hero\": \"Captured on the preloader: a beige graph-paper field (12px grid) with a small cobalt logo tile dead centre, handwritten X/Y cursor coordinates top-left and an email in architect's hand lettering top-right. In one frame the image narrows to the right 70%, leaving a graph-paper gutter at left for text.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"Navigation is a compact white capsule about 280px wide, centred at the top with square corners: icon tile and wordmark, three mono links, and a navy button with a small orange square inside. Top-right and bottom-left cells hold a black-and-white dithered canvas crossed by large pale-grey blade shapes that ignore cell borders. The bottom-right quadrant splits into a black cell (24px white summary, mono caps action row at its base) and a mint cell (second statement, client-logo marquee along the bottom).\",\n  \"type\": \"Suisse Intl at weight 450 for everything, tracking about -0.02em; Suisse Intl Mono in small caps for actions, bullet lists and footer. Then a white row where the left half is empty and a 24px long-form text runs only in the right column.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"stats\",\n    \"description\": \"Stair-stepped tiles instead of a row. Four lime circular markers with a dotted glyph are pinned across the terrain, each followed by a three-line mono caption in white.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"features\",\n    \"description\": \"A full-bleed foggy render of a weather-station mast among rocks and shrubs. Upper left, a three-line heading preceded by a small diagonal arrow. At left, a frosted-glass rounded card about 310px wide holds a small line chart under a large figure. Right of the mast, a stack of five translucent rows about 420px wide, each a mono index number, an uppercase mono label and a plus sign, works as an accordion over the image.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"showcase\",\n    \"description\": \"White section. Each carries a bracketed mono label top-left, a lime circular arrow button top-right and a two-line white title over the image at bottom-left.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"A blurred dark foliage photograph as background. Then a hairline, office cities in lime at about 36px on the left and four columns of mono uppercase links on the right; a thin legal row with a back-to-top link at the very bottom.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Overlay hairline reticles and mono data tags on an organic 3D object so that measurement becomes the visual subject.\",\n   \"Dock text in the corners of a full-viewport scene (headline top-left, statement bottom-left, hint bottom-right) and let the object own the centre.\",\n   \"Confine one pale accent colour to small squares and tags, then spend it once at full scale on a footer wordmark.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-made-with-gsap-1\",\n  \"name\": \"Made With Gsap\",\n  \"url\": \"https://madewithgsap.com/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"dev-tool\",\n  \"score\": 7.9,\n  \"idea\": \"The hero is the product: a draggable vertical reel of effect demos runs through the middle of the headline, which is split and pushed to both edges to make room.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"crisp\",\n   \"energetic\",\n   \"technical\",\n   \"confident\",\n   \"playful\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"other: split-headline-flanking-centre-reel\",\n  \"hero\": \"White viewport. Bottom-left a two-line 18px statement; bottom-right a grey mono drag hint.\",\n  \"type\": \"LayGrotesk medium, tracking −0.02em, sentence case, for headlines (47px in the hero, about 5.5vw mid-page, 17vw in the closing banner) and 22px body; PP Neue Montreal Mono uppercase at 12px for nav, buttons and labels. The footer proper is one row: a newsletter heading and capsule input with inline submit on the left 40%, three small mono link columns on the right, and a legal line at the very bottom.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Split a single-line headline in two and pin the halves to the left and right edges so the media sits inside the sentence.\",\n   \"Make the hero media a reel whose previous and next items peek from the top and bottom edges, signalling drag without arrows.\",\n   \"End on a white rounded sheet rising over a black page, with the final call set so large it is cropped by the sheet's top edge.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-dialkit\",\n  \"name\": \"DialKit\",\n  \"url\": \"https://www.dialkit.dev/\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"dev-tool\",\n  \"score\": 7.9,\n  \"idea\": \"The headline is the demo: three floating dial controls from the product sit on top of the sentence and change its weight, spacing and effects live.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"dark\",\n   \"precise\",\n   \"tactile\",\n   \"playful\",\n   \"minimal\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"type-poster\",\n  \"hero\": \"Near-black viewport with no logo and no nav beyond a two-word audience toggle (active white, inactive grey) in 13px at top-left. All of it lives in the left half while the right photo panel has advanced to a shelf-wall image.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"gallery\",\n    \"description\": \"A header row with a tiny bold caps label at left and a script follow-us link with arrow at right, then three portrait images (about 3:5) with 12px rounded corners in a row, the third cropped by the column edge to imply a carousel. Inside it, a pinned two-column layout: narrow list at left, a wide right column of stacked panels each followed by a short title and paragraph.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"proof\",\n    \"description\": \"Directly under the hero the ribbon canvas continues behind one row of white client logos running edge to edge, cut off at both sides, over a faint dot grid. Left column, about 25% wide: a tiny mono label with a bullet, then four stacked feature names at about 1.6vw in light weight; the active one is navy and the other three pale grey, the active state stepping down as you scroll. Right column from 50% to the margin: a tall stack of roughly 4:3 demo panels, each followed by a one-line title and a four-line paragraph. Panel grounds alternate between ribbon render, pale grey and navy.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"The footer returns to the dark ribbon canvas at full viewport height. Social icons sit top-left and two small link columns start about 75% across. In the lower right, a two-line closing statement at about 1.5vw with a pink and a dark button beneath; ribbons sweep in from the bottom-left to fill the empty half. A hairline and one row of legal links in mono capitals close the page.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Pin a short list of feature names on the left and let only the active name hold full ink while the others drop to pale grey, as a stack of demo panels scrolls past on the right.\",\n   \"Set every interactive label (nav, buttons, tags) in uppercase mono and everything else in a light grotesk, so controls read as a separate system from the copy.\",\n   \"Make the light content area a sheet with rounded top corners that slides up over the dark hero art, then bring the same art back for the footer.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-spatial\",\n  \"name\": \"Spatial\",\n  \"url\": \"https://spatial-festival.com/\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"event\",\n  \"score\": 7.7,\n  \"idea\": \"Typography behaves like sound in a room: plain black statements swell, stretch and bend through an empty white viewport as you scroll.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"stark\",\n   \"experimental\",\n   \"precise\",\n   \"kinetic\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"type-poster\",\n  \"hero\": \"A white viewport holding only the festival dates: two centred lines in Neue Haas Grotesk Roman at roughly 6.7vw, black, tight leading, sitting at the exact vertical middle and spanning about half the width. Large empty fields above and below; no image, no button, no supporting copy. The header is the only other element: a light uppercase wordmark with tight tracking flush to the top-left corner at a 20px inset, and nine small bold uppercase links in a row across the top right. Mobile is the same poster at 40px with a two-line hamburger.\",\n  \"type\": \"One face, Neue Haas Grotesk Display 55 Roman, for everything: statements from 56px up to about 10vw, 13px body, bold 13px uppercase navigation, a timetable at about 16px with tight leading. Statement lines are distorted per glyph, each letter scaled to a different width and height.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#ffffff #000000 #e8a25c — Pure black on pure white; the programme section inverts to white on black. The only colour is the amber haze of a single photograph.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Almost none. The images are canvas-rendered text statements warped and magnified until letter fragments become abstract black shapes cropped by the viewport. One warm, hazy venue photograph sits inset at half width beside body copy, square-cornered.\",\n  \"layout\": \"Full width with 10 to 20px margins. Opens with one centred statement per screen, then drops into left-aligned two-column copy and, further down, edge-to-edge four-column timetables. The swing between empty poster screens and tightly packed listings is the page's rhythm.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"A run of full-viewport white screens, each carrying one centred two-line sentence. The text is drawn on canvas and deformed: letters within a word have different widths and heights and baselines wobble. Between screens the type is magnified so far that only the strokes and counters of a few letters cross the frame, cropped on every side, while a small readable version of the next sentence appears inside the wreckage of the previous one.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"A calm reset: a three-line centred statement at about 5vw in undistorted type fills the top half. At the bottom, a column of 16px body copy about 650px wide sits flush to the left margin, and an amber-toned photograph starts at the horizontal centre and runs to the right margin with square corners, cropped by the fold.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"list\",\n    \"description\": \"Black full-bleed section. Day headings are single small lines above a hairline; under each, a four-column table spans the full width: artist flush left, format at one third, room at two thirds, time range right-aligned at the far edge. Rows are about 35px high with a hairline between each, all in the same 30px grotesk with no bold; changeovers are marked by rows in capitals.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Open with a single factual line (the dates) centred on an otherwise empty white screen instead of a branded hero.\",\n   \"Scale each letter of a statement independently in width and height so plain grotesk type looks as if it is resonating.\",\n   \"Set a programme as a full-width four-column hairline table in one size and weight, times right-aligned, on an inverted background.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-aardvark-book-club\",\n  \"name\": \"Aardvark Book Club\",\n  \"url\": \"https://aardvarkbookclub.com\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"ecommerce\",\n  \"score\": 7.7,\n  \"idea\": \"A book club dressed as a sweet shop: fat black type, tumbling 3D books and boxes on wavy colour fields, annotated with handwritten asides.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"playful\",\n   \"loud\",\n   \"bookish\",\n   \"warm\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"split-text-media\",\n  \"hero\": \"A saturated yellow field with two large wavy blobs, pale yellow then orange, rising from the bottom. A three-line headline in Champ Bold, black, at about 8.3vw with leading under 0.85, is flush to a 15px left margin and reaches 60% across. Beneath it: a four-line paragraph 310px wide and a magenta split button (label plus arrow square). Right of centre a 3D hardback in navy and pink tilts 20 degrees, 600px tall; another book is cropped by the top-left corner, a third by the bottom edge. A purple handwritten note sits rotated at far right. Nav: pale-yellow pill links centred, an orange login button, black round social icons.\",\n  \"type\": \"Champ Bold, an ultra-heavy wide sans with a looped g, for headings at 120px with tight tracking and leading; Degular for 18px body and pill labels; a purple handwritten script (Hello Organichand) for rotated margin notes and step labels. Three distinct voices.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#ffd249 #faed8f #f9a21f #ffdbfd #a4f6f8 #fd48f2 — Each section owns one flat candy colour: yellow hero, white shelf, pink steps, cyan unboxing, deep violet footer. Type stays black; buttons are magenta.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"3D-rendered hardbacks and a patterned shipping box, cut out and tilted, floating over flat wavy vector shapes; real book covers on tilted coloured cards; black line drawings of figures on step cards. Nothing sits square to the grid.\",\n  \"layout\": \"Sections are full-width panels with roughly 80px corner radius inset about 20px from the viewport, each a different colour. Headings alternate left and centre; cards overlap and rotate a few degrees; handwritten notes are tucked beside headings at an angle.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"showcase\",\n    \"description\": \"White band. A centred black heading at 5.5vw over a two-line subline, with a rotated handwritten note at its upper left. Below, a horizontal row of book covers, each on a rounded colour-matched card with a small tag pill at top-left; cards tilt alternately by 3 degrees at staggered heights, the last cropped by the right edge, with two round arrow buttons above at right. Later, covers give way to same-coloured info cards with genre pills, heavy title and blurb.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"how-it-works\",\n    \"description\": \"A pale-pink rounded panel with lighter wavy shapes inside. Heavy black heading at left with a handwritten aside beside it; a small round logo stamp and a magenta split button at right. Along the bottom, four portrait cards about 250px wide in cyan, magenta, yellow and violet overlap like a fanned hand, each rotated a few degrees, with a handwritten step label at top, a black line drawing in the middle and a heavy caption at the foot.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"A full-viewport cyan rounded panel containing only a 3D shipping box wrapped in a wavy magenta, violet and black pattern, centred. Across the scroll it goes from closed and tilted to lid open, growing to about 57% of the viewport width, with a single handwritten note at its right. No heading and no button.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"The preceding white section ends in large rounded bottom corners over a deep violet footer. Left: white logo, two store badges, two magenta round social icons. Centre: the patterned box again, cropped by the bottom edge. Right: a small heavy heading, a white rounded email field and a magenta split button. A black legal strip closes the page.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Give each section one flat saturated colour inside a large-radius inset panel and keep the type black across all of them.\",\n   \"Add rotated handwritten margin notes beside headings to carry secondary facts in a second voice.\",\n   \"Fan step cards so they overlap and tilt instead of sitting in an even grid.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-rendez-vous-franceclat\",\n  \"name\": \"Rendez-vous Francéclat\",\n  \"url\": \"https://rendez-vous.franceclat.fr\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"event\",\n  \"score\": 7.7,\n  \"idea\": \"A hot gradient sliced into three glass panes that double as the column grid for navigation and content.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"radiant\",\n   \"graphic\",\n   \"precise\",\n   \"contemporary\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"left-statement-quiet\",\n  \"hero\": \"A full-viewport gradient runs from white at the far left through orange to crimson on the right, sliced into three equal vertical panes that each restart the gradient, like fluted glass. At 37–63% height on the left: a stacked light-caps programme logo, then the event name in heavy lowercase grotesk on two lines, about 7vw, with two mono metadata blocks above aligned to column starts and a sponsor logo below. The right half is empty colour. A black rectangular CTA sits bottom-right.\",\n  \"type\": \"ABC Diatype throughout: heavy, tightly tracked lowercase for the event name and 68px section heads (-0.03em), medium 22–28px for statements and paragraphs. A monospaced cut in uppercase 14px handles nav, dates and numbered labels. A stacked light-caps logo adds a third voice.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#f8652b #de194b #ffffff #000000 #fcd9c8 #6f7478 — Orange-to-crimson gradient for hero and footer, fading out to pure white for the informational middle; one desaturated grey photo section. One full-bleed grey architectural photo with a blurred figure; a pale isometric line drawing of the venue; logos. No product photography visible.\",\n  \"layout\": \"Built on thirds and a visible column grid: nav stacks, metadata and text blocks all start on column lines, and white sections expose the vertical hairlines. Left-anchored; large empty areas on the right. Gradient, photo and white sections alternate over 20 screens.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"As the hero scrolls, the gradient pales to white at the bottom and a two-line bold 28px statement sits in the right third, aligned to the third pane's edge. Next, a full-bleed grey architectural photo carries two paragraphs of white 22px text across the full width with 16px margins, the second at reduced opacity. The event lockup reappears ghosted at the bottom with mono practical details and a white rectangular CTA.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"features\",\n    \"description\": \"White field with the column grid exposed as vertical hairlines. A bold 40px heading resolves from blur at lower-left. Then a pale isometric line drawing of the venue spans the left four columns, a narrow paragraph about 230px wide sits mid-page, and along the bottom numbered items step down column by column: mono index above an underlined mono uppercase link.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"contact\",\n    \"description\": \"Footer. The paned gradient returns. A partner name top-left; a two-line bold 36px sign-off in pale peach; a newsletter heading with a white input joined to a black button and a consent checkbox. The right two panes hold small bold link lists under mono labels. A hairline and a mono legal row close it.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Slice a full-bleed gradient into three vertical panes that each restart the gradient to get a fluted-glass look from colour alone.\",\n   \"Distribute the navigation as plain mono text stacks at the top of each pane instead of a nav bar, so the grid is the header.\",\n   \"Leave the layout grid's vertical hairlines visible in white sections and step numbered items down along the columns.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-when-you-wish-upon-a-starboy\",\n  \"name\": \"starboy\",\n  \"url\": \"https://lilguy.net/\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"physical-product\",\n  \"score\": 7.7,\n  \"idea\": \"A tiny gadget shown enormous: product renders so large the screen crops them, wrapped around a nursery-rhyme headline in fat lowercase.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"playful\",\n   \"glossy\",\n   \"loud\",\n   \"toy-like\",\n   \"deadpan\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"split-text-media\",\n  \"hero\": \"No nav, logo or button. Off-white ground. The right half holds the headline: five stacked lines of very bold rounded lowercase at 13vw (187px), right-aligned and almost touching the right edge, with tight negative tracking and leading under 0.9, so the stack runs from 5% below the top to past the fold and the last line's descenders are cut off. The left 60% is one transparent-shelled, star-shaped device rendered at huge scale (yellow circuit board, round black screen), rotated and cropped by the top, left and bottom edges, its right-hand points tucking behind the letters. A chrome keyring loop peeks in at bottom-right.\",\n  \"type\": \"Milling Triplex 1mm, bold, for the headline at 187px in lowercase with -0.055em tracking, one or two words per line over eleven lines; the same family at about 13px for body copy, product names and footer links, all lowercase. Two sizes only, a 14:1 jump.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#f9f9f9 #2a2b2d #f5d900 #8d8e96 #b8a45c #2f6fe0 — Off-white page with charcoal type. Colour lives in the objects: circuit-board yellow, chrome, matte black, brass. A small blue logo in the footer is the only interface colour.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Photoreal renders of star-shaped devices in four materials, cut out with no background or cast shadow, scaled well beyond the viewport, each rotated differently and cropped by the edges. Accessories are shown small and centred in grid cells.\",\n  \"layout\": \"Three acts: three screens of oversized renders tumbling diagonally with the headline set right, then left; one screen holding a single narrow text column and nothing else; then a three-column hairline-divided product grid running edge to edge with no outer margin.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"gallery\",\n    \"description\": \"The second and third screens are only renders: a matte-black star and a chrome star overlap on a diagonal, each wider than half the viewport and cropped by two edges. No captions or interface.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"A single column of 13px lowercase text about 290px wide, placed roughly 15% from the left and starting at the top of the viewport: five short paragraphs, the first in medium weight. The remaining three-quarters of the screen is blank off-white. No heading, image or button accompanies it.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"showcase\",\n    \"description\": \"Three equal columns span the full viewport width, separated by faint 1px vertical and horizontal lines. Each cell holds one cut-out render centred with generous air and a caption row along its bottom edge: product name at left, price with stock count or a coming-soon note in grey at right, all 13px lowercase. The footer is one row: small blue logo left, five text links right.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Scale the product until two or three viewport edges crop it, and let its silhouette tuck behind the headline letters.\",\n   \"Break a sentence into one or two words per line at 13vw, right-aligned for the first half and left-aligned for the second, so the headline spans several screens.\",\n   \"Follow a loud hero with one tiny text column on an otherwise empty screen; the drop in scale does the pacing.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-warm-fuzzy\",\n  \"name\": \"Warm & Fuzzy\",\n  \"url\": \"https://www.warmnfuzzy.tv/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"agency\",\n  \"score\": 7.7,\n  \"idea\": \"A showreel-first studio site in which every section takes one flat, loud colour (blue, black, yellow) under heavy grotesk type and a chunky custom wordmark.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"loud\",\n   \"playful\",\n   \"saturated\",\n   \"confident\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"video-reel\",\n  \"hero\": \"The showreel plays full-bleed with a visible film-grain overlay and no scrim. A chunky hand-cut wordmark sits top left, 16px from the edges; the same top line continues with a one-sentence status link, a tiny thumbnail beside the latest project's name, and three caps links at the far right, all white over the footage. A small green caps play label floats at dead centre. The tagline is anchored bottom left, 16px from both edges, in white grotesk caps at 47px (3.3vw) on one line spanning 56% of the width. A tiny square pause control sits bottom right.\",\n  \"type\": \"SuisseIntl throughout, rendering heavy, tracked -0.027em: a 47px caps tagline, a caps section title at 9.4vw, statement paragraphs around 5vw with tight leading, and 10 to 11px caps captions. The logo is custom chunky lettering with wobbly cut-paper counters.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#000000 #190bb6 #f7dd47 #ffffff #e9479f #1fc27a — Each section is a flat field: ultramarine blue, black, yellow, then blue again. White type on blue and black, black on yellow; a green play label is the only small accent.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Commercial stills and video (candy-coloured CG worlds, product renders, live-action frames) in square-cornered thumbnails of mixed aspect ratios, with a grain layer over the whole page and floating glossy 3D sticker objects.\",\n  \"layout\": \"Tight 16px outer margins and edge-to-edge type. Sections are told apart by background colour rather than spacing: a blue statement set in the right two-thirds, a black packed work wall, a yellow full-width paragraph, a blue footer.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"work\",\n    \"description\": \"On black, a tiny caps motto sits top left, then a caps section title at about 9vw flush left with a small underlined link at the far right on its baseline. Under each image a 10px caps line gives the project name left and the year in grey right.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"A yellow field filled edge to edge by one paragraph in black heavy grotesk at roughly 5vw with very tight leading, left-aligned at the 16px margin. Several lines contain deliberate word-sized gaps, as if the text flowed around something, and a small tilted image chip floats over the first lines, covering parts of words.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"A full-screen blue field. A top row of tiny caps, email left and three links right, sits above a hairline. A glossy 3D sticker object hangs near the top centre. The chunky wordmark runs the full page width at the bottom in white, about a fifth of the viewport tall, above a bar of tiny caps links divided by vertical hairlines.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Give every section one flat saturated background and change it at each section break, keeping type strictly black or white.\",\n   \"Pack work thumbnails at mixed widths and heights with 8px gaps and a two-part micro caption (name left, year right) under each.\",\n   \"End with the wordmark at full page width on a colour field, with all utility links reduced to a tiny caps bar split by vertical hairlines.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-the-sapphic-bar-index\",\n  \"name\": \"The Sapphic Bar Index\",\n  \"url\": \"https://sapphicindex.com\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"culture\",\n  \"score\": 7.7,\n  \"idea\": \"A nightlife guide dressed as a mock research dossier: taped snapshots, field notes, sticker stamps and a big numeric score for every bar.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"cheeky\",\n   \"scrapbook\",\n   \"warm\",\n   \"editorial\",\n   \"tongue-in-cheek\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"split-text-media\",\n  \"hero\": \"The desktop capture caught the hero before it animated in (only an empty two-cell box and a black bar show); the mobile capture, which is the desktop layout scaled down, reveals it. Small text and a black rounded button sit beneath. The right half holds a tall torn-edge photograph of a hand raising a cocktail, taped at the top, tilted about 8 degrees and running off the top edge, a paper-clipped note on its corner.\",\n  \"type\": \"Three custom faces per the digest: a tall heavy condensed grotesque for the 119px title, a typewriter-style mono (61% of text) for bar names in bold caps, labels and notes, and a small sans for intro copy at 12px. Column three: a bold label over five bullet lines. Column four: a small label above a two-digit score in heavy numerals inside a thin circle.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"A legend row of five die-cut badges spaced evenly across the column directly under the hero, each a different silhouette and colour: pink oval, orange rounded rectangle with notched corners, yellow ticket, blue star, sage triangle. Each has a thick dark outline, a slight rotation and two lines of condensed caps inside. Smaller rectangular versions are reused as category tags in the list rows.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"contact\",\n    \"description\": \"Submission form as a clip-out coupon: a pink rounded card inside a thin outlined frame, with a large beige paper cut-out of scissors overlapping the top-left corner. A cobalt strip beneath repeats a one-line credit across the full width.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Give every list row a large circled numeric score in its own right-hand column so a directory reads as a ranking.\",\n   \"Present photos as taped, torn-edge snapshots rotated a few degrees, repeating the same tape detail on every image for consistency.\",\n   \"Define a small set of die-cut sticker badges once as a legend, then reuse them in miniature as category tags in the rows.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-textmode-overlay\",\n  \"name\": \"Textmode Overlay\",\n  \"url\": \"https://extension.textmode.art\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"dev-tool\",\n  \"score\": 7.7,\n  \"idea\": \"The whole site is rendered in the product's medium: one bitmap face and live character-art fields, laid out like a terminal instrument panel with a numbered rail.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"retro-terminal\",\n   \"dark\",\n   \"precise\",\n   \"dense\",\n   \"technical\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"type-poster\",\n  \"hero\": \"Black viewport framed like an instrument panel. The headline, two lines of cream pixel caps at 11vw, is left-aligned at mid-height, its last word in a slanted variant. Below a hairline, a bottom strip holds a short description left and two wide rectangular buttons.\",\n  \"type\": \"Monogram Extended, a bitmap face, for 96% of text: 160px headline caps, 24px body, small caps labels, one weight, with a slanted variant for the accent word. Inter appears only in the cookie dialog. Hierarchy comes from size and case alone.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#0a0a0a #f2f2ec #3b3b3b #b11226 #9a9a95 — Black with cream text and mid-grey glyph texture. The last two sections invert to cream with black type.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Live canvas renderings: a swirling white, grey and red brush-stroke animation shown beside its character-art conversion, plus ambient character fields as backgrounds. Each section starts with a small slash-separated caption and a large caps heading.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"showcase\",\n    \"description\": \"A wide bordered frame split vertically by a draggable handle: the left half shows the source animation (thick white, grey and crimson swirls on black), the right half the same frame converted to scattered characters, with small outlined tags in the top corners naming each side. A soft crimson radial glow is centred behind the middle column and fades into the outer two, the only shading in the section.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"features\",\n    \"description\": \"Left 40%: a two-by-three table of bordered cells, each with a tiny index number top-left, a caps feature name at mid-left and a small grey quantity bottom-right. Right 60%: one large cell with a two-line caps heading upper-left, a crimson glow in the top-right corner and two lines of description along the bottom. The rail tab at the right edge names the section.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"cta\",\n    \"description\": \"The close inverts to cream: a pale character field with a faint red cluster at upper right, a slash-separated caption, then a two-line black pixel-caps headline at about 8vw that echoes the hero and reuses the slanted last word, and one small outlined rectangular button. Footer links follow in three small columns on the same cream ground.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Add a fixed right-edge rail of section numbers where the active number sprouts a labelled tab into the content area.\",\n   \"Draw the page as bordered cells with 1px lines and put a tiny index top-left and a small quantity bottom-right in each feature cell.\",\n   \"End on an inverted, light-ground repeat of the hero headline so the close mirrors the opening in the opposite palette.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-hebbia\",\n  \"name\": \"Hebbia\",\n  \"url\": \"https://design.hebbia.com\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"studio-portfolio\",\n  \"score\": 7.7,\n  \"idea\": \"An AI-finance company's in-house design team presents itself as a luxury print house: inscriptional serif capitals on near-black, a ledger-ruled specimen table of its output, and a paper invitation card to recruit.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"opulent\",\n   \"nocturnal\",\n   \"editorial\",\n   \"deadpan\",\n   \"crafted\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"type-poster\",\n  \"hero\": \"Near-black viewport, roughly 90% empty. The statement is three centred lines of white serif capitals stacked in the middle of the screen: a seven-letter word, a two-letter word, then a long word in italic with a full stop, giving a wide, narrow, wider silhouette about 55% of the viewport across at its widest. Capital height is roughly a tenth of the viewport height with tight leading. Along the bottom edge a full-width framed strip shows the top 60px of a chrome 3D render, announcing the next section.\",\n  \"type\": \"Edict carries nearly everything: roman capitals for statements, a swash italic with flourished terminals for the second half of the section title, small caps for credits. Body copy is small, centred and sparse.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#0a0a0a #ffffff #1c1818 #efebe2 #2a35c9 #b0703c — Near-black field with pure white type. Colour arrives only through thumbnails (electric blue, copper, amber sunsets) and one cream paper card; the footer warms to a brown-black.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Chrome and copper 3D 'ingot' renders, line-screen and ASCII portraits, dark product-UI crops, warm cinematic photographs and a film-still video.
