A two-line sans paragraph is centred well below, after a gap as tall as the title.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"gallery\",\n    \"description\": \"A four-column table bounded by hairlines. The header row appears to stay pinned while rows scroll beneath it.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"cta\",\n    \"description\": \"A cream textured-paper card about 70% of the page width, rotated a degree or two, with a thin inset keyline border. It sits on the black field like a printed invitation and is cropped by the fold rather than framed whole.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"A mostly empty warm-black screen: a small folder icon centred at 60% height, three lines of tiny serif caps credit beneath it, and at the very bottom a one-line ticker of small-caps facts separated by dots, with an oversized italic two-word phrase overlapping the ticker's centre.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Set a three-line statement in serif capitals and italicise only the last word, so emphasis comes from slant rather than colour or weight.\",\n   \"Present mixed work as a ruled table: named columns divided by hairlines, one tile per cell at varying aspect ratios, header row pinned.\",\n   \"Break a dark page with one physical object, a slightly rotated textured-paper card with an inset keyline, and put the call to action on it.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-revelatio-studio\",\n  \"name\": \"Revelatio Studio\",\n  \"url\": \"https://revelatio.studio/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"agency\",\n  \"score\": 7.6,\n  \"idea\": \"The team photograph is the hero: it starts as a small CRT-curved mosaic of typographic glyphs and resolves into a full-bleed group portrait as you scroll.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"dark\",\n   \"restrained\",\n   \"technical\",\n   \"human\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"bottom-anchored-type\",\n  \"hero\": \"Pure black viewport. Nothing else; roughly 80% of the screen is black.\",\n  \"type\": \"Neue Haas Grotesk Text 55 Roman is the only face and weight. Logo top-left, a grey centred nav prompt, a small pill with a glowing dot top-right. Carousel chevrons sit at the far left and right edges at product height. The bottom fifth is empty.\",\n  \"type\": \"Three voices: a chrome extended techno wordmark as image; Untitled Serif 400 at 38px with -0.026em tracking for taglines and body; ISO mono for specs and caps eyebrows. Section heads switch to a tight heavy Untitled Sans near 36px. Nothing exceeds 3.6vw.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#1c1c1c #c8c5ba #6e6f6a #5b5d45 #f1f1ef #2d2d2d — Charcoal base with white text; colour comes only from photographs in grey-olive, concrete and amber. One section flips to dark text over a pale blurred photo.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"One clean product render, then shallow-focus macro photographs of the translucent drive on cutting mats, concrete and fabric, graded olive-grey with grain. Full-bleed bands with feathered edges, plus a row of rounded cards of unequal widths.\",\n  \"layout\": \"Centred hero, then full-bleed photo bands each carrying one short text group placed differently: top-left, centre-right over a card, bottom-left, centred. No cards or dividers; the photo's soft blur is the only background.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"gallery\",\n    \"description\": \"A full-width macro photo band fades out through a blurred lower edge. On charcoal beneath it, one row of four rounded-corner image cards of unequal widths (one double-width, three single) with narrow gaps, each a tightly cropped lifestyle shot in a different colour temperature. The row is cut by the viewport bottom; further down one card grows taller and pins beside a short text group.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"showcase\",\n    \"description\": \"Dark band over a concrete-wall photograph. The band cross-dissolves into an olive bokeh photo holding a centred mono equation, heading and one serif line whose quantities are joined by italic conjunctions.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"Two small white script-lettered badges side by side at top centre, like garment labels, with a tiny pill link beneath, then a mostly empty charcoal field. Inside, the three words of the title are spread along the top edge at left, centre and right in bold condensed caps. A small line-diagram logo sits below. Two left-aligned text blocks at 2.5vw in the same heavy condensed face, tightly leaded: five lines of event details, four of description. Bottom edge: credits left, an RSVP box centre, a small link right. Square-cornered and at very different sizes, from small thumbnails to near full-height frames, placed off-grid on flat tan.\",\n  \"layout\": \"After the full-bleed opener the page becomes a flat tan field where photos are placed irregularly, one small at left, one mid-size near centre, one tall at right, with wide gaps. No captions; all text lives in the pinned card, which partly overlaps the images.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"contact\",\n    \"description\": \"On scroll the invitation panel collapses to a card pinned in the top-left corner, about half the viewport wide and 22% tall, flush with the edges. One image carries several sequential captions.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"Very dark green field. The left half holds a huge flat grey flower silhouette bleeding off the left and bottom edges; the right half is black with a few tiny video thumbnails drifting through. Navigation is six small bold white words pinned to the frame: three links across the top edge, the three-part studio name across the bottom edge.\",\n  \"type\": \"Elza only, weight 900, uppercase, tracking -0.05em so letters nearly collide, line-height under 1. Title colour changes on every slide; nothing else does.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"There is no footer block. The last screen is simply another project slide, and the studio name fixed along the bottom edge in three pieces (first word bottom-left, ampersand bottom-centre, last word bottom-right) does the footer's job on every screen, mirroring the three nav words fixed along the top edge at the same size and weight.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Break the studio name into three words pinned bottom-left, bottom-centre and bottom-right, mirroring three nav links across the top, so the viewport frame itself is the logo.\",\n   \"Give each project slide one flat pastel used only for its title and tags, so a colour change is the sole signal that the project changed.\",\n   \"Split the viewport into two media columns that scroll at different offsets and set the title across the seam so the type stitches the halves together.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-bleibtgleich26\",\n  \"name\": \"bleibtgleich’26\",\n  \"url\": \"https://bleibtgleich.dev\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"personal-portfolio\",\n  \"score\": 7.5,\n  \"idea\": \"One thin vertical rule runs down the page and a tight bold grotesk sentence wraps around it, words stepping from one side of the line to the other.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"stark\",\n   \"typographic\",\n   \"Swiss\",\n   \"witty\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"type-poster\",\n  \"hero\": \"White page, black type. The tagline continues below at the same size, flush to the band's left edge, running past the fold. The upper half is otherwise blank. The handle is split into two pale-grey words fixed in the bottom corners; a black menu pill sits top-right.\",\n  \"type\": \"Akzidenz Grotesk Pro medium only, -0.05em tracking, line-height about 0.9. Pale grey is used for the ghosted corner wordmark and a few small square tiles; tiny coloured rings inside those tiles are the only hue.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Almost none: a black blob avatar, a few 85px grey tiles each with a coloured ring, and a canvas dome of small tilted project thumbnails floating between two words.\",\n  \"layout\": \"Everything hangs off one vertical axis at 37%: lines start either at the axis or one indent to its left, giving a stepped rag. Very wide white margins. Sections are separated by a full screen of white rather than rules or colour.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"A 90px sentence is typeset word by word around the vertical rule: one word ends just left of the rule, the next starts just right of it, and the following line is centred beneath both. Above the sentence a row of five 85px pale-grey squares, each with a small coloured ring at its centre, is spaced unevenly along one baseline, with a three-line 13px description under the second.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"work\",\n    \"description\": \"The heading first appears as one centred line near the bottom of an empty screen, then its two halves separate to the far left and far right edges at mid-height. Nothing else is on the screen.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"proof\",\n    \"description\": \"The heading is broken into an ampersand alone in the left margin and two words stepped over three lines with a hyphen break and a growing indent. Below it a four-column table at 11px: year, site name, awarding body, award. Hairline rules sit under every row, columns align to the hero's band, and year groups are separated by a blank row.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"contact\",\n    \"description\": \"The closing sentence is stepped over four lines with shifting indents, right of centre. To its left two tiny grey captions and an email address at 11px. Under it three 36px outlined circles with social initials, centred, then the handle at about 44px centred on the bottom edge with tiny legal text in the two corners.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Draw one 1px vertical rule and typeset a large sentence around it, alternating words to either side so the line becomes the text's spine.\",\n   \"Split the logotype into two words, ghost them at about 10% grey, and fix one in each bottom corner of the viewport.\",\n   \"Leave the top half of the hero blank and start the name at 50% height so the headline runs off the fold and pulls the scroll.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-lorenzo-bocchi-photography\",\n  \"name\": \"Lorenzo Bocchi – Shot on iPhone\",\n  \"url\": \"https://shotoniphone.lorenzobocchi.com\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"personal-portfolio\",\n  \"score\": 7.5,\n  \"idea\": \"Black-and-white phone photographs fly through dark 3D space as a twisting ribbon, and the viewer chooses how the archive is arranged (reel, wall, trail, drift; flow, grid, map).\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"dark\",\n   \"cinematic\",\n   \"quiet\",\n   \"spatial\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"immersive-webgl\",\n  \"hero\": \"Pure black canvas filling the viewport. Behind them a single word in ultra-bold condensed caps spans 80% of the width, its letters half the viewport tall, in a grey only a few points lighter than the background. Four pill-shaped control groups sit in the corners: menu label top-left, three view modes top-right, two round icon buttons bottom-left, four layout modes bottom-right.\",\n  \"type\": \"GeistSans around 14px inside the pill controls is the only readable text. No headings or captions.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#000000 #191919 #262626 #383838 #e6e6e6 — Black and greys only; the photographs are all monochrome, so the brightest values on the page are image highlights. Controls are dark grey capsules with a black active segment.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Black-and-white travel and street photographs, all portrait, with a soft vignette, mapped onto slightly curved cards in WebGL; only cards near the focal plane are lit, the rest fall into darkness.\",\n  \"layout\": \"One fixed viewport with no document flow. Content floats in the centre 50% of the screen; interface is pushed to the four corners with 16px insets, leaving edges and middle free for the image stream.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"gallery\",\n    \"description\": \"Scrolling does not move a page; it advances the ribbon. Cards leaving focus darken to charcoal silhouettes that continue the curve toward the top-left and bottom-right corners, so the path stays readable even when the images are not.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"Navigation is four floating capsules rather than a bar. Bottom line: two tiny swatches left, four layout-mode words centred with the active one underlined, grey copyright right.\",\n  \"type\": \"One custom grotesk (OTF Obys NG), one weight, two sizes only: 13px for every label and 94px (6.5vw) uppercase at -0.055em for the three-line stacked title and the bottom caption. Corners hold the small text, the centre axis holds title, thumbnails and caption.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"work\",\n    \"description\": \"On scroll the ring flattens into one horizontal row of small thumbnails, about 95px wide and 230px apart, at mid-height. Around it six small image tiles, each about 10% of viewport width, are spaced on an ellipse at roughly 10, 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 o'clock; each is skewed as if turned about its vertical axis so it reads as a parallelogram. Tiles show photographs, a white logo card and glyph crops. About 80% of the screen is empty. A cookie notice sits bottom-right in the capture.\",\n  \"type\": \"Clarkson and Clarkson Light only. The middle holds either the ring of tiles or one full-bleed asset.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"gallery\",\n    \"description\": \"A slide fills the viewport edge to edge with one asset on black, or sits as a black panel inset about 75px from the sides on charcoal. Header text remains in the top corners.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"The logo slide flips the background to pure white and all chrome to black. Bottom-left: a four-line stacked nav with a dot marking the current item.\",\n  \"type\": \"ABC Diatype in uppercase at 16px for names and titles, with numbers and nav near 10px; Migra, a sharp display serif, appears once in the centred tagline in tiny tightly set capitals. Scrolling swaps the footage underneath while the overlay text changes in place.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"Mobile variant: the video fills the whole screen with no frame or rounded corners, cropped to a vertical slice of the footage. Chrome disappears; only three pieces of small text remain at mid-height on the left, with the index number at the edge, the film title beside it and the client name on a second line beneath, all in translucent white.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Inset the full-screen video 12 to 16px with rounded corners on a pale page colour so the film looks mounted rather than bled.\",\n   \"Split the wordmark across the top-left and top-right corners and split client and title across the two ends of the midline, keeping the image centre empty.\",\n   \"Keep every label at body size; with strong footage, 16px white capitals are enough hierarchy.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-2xa-studio\",\n  \"name\": \"2xA Studio\",\n  \"url\": \"https://2xa.studio/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"studio-portfolio\",\n  \"score\": 7.5,\n  \"idea\": \"Computation is the aesthetic: the grid, the loader, the lettering and the body text all behave like running code rather than a finished layout.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"technical\",\n   \"austere\",\n   \"glitchy\",\n   \"nocturnal\",\n   \"experimental\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"other: loader-as-hero, then giant-wordmark\",\n  \"hero\": \"Captured in its loading state, which is itself designed. Once loaded, the panel holds a dot-and-dash wordmark spanning the full width with two small square generative canvases beneath.\",\n  \"type\": \"2XAMONOVF, a custom condensed pixel-edged mono, carries nav, labels and body at 19-24px. Extreme jump, 10vw against 12px columns.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#0f0f0f #030303 #fdfdfd #e6e6e6 #d4372c #f2cf1d — Near-black and white only for the interface; sections flip between them. A row of seven single mono words is justified across the bottom edge like a spaced-out sentence.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"gallery\",\n    \"description\": \"On the dark ground, square generative canvases about 13% of viewport width sit at irregular column positions with large black gaps between them: a white tile with red marks, a black-and-white ASCII noise field, a low-poly gradient form, an ASCII rendering of a paragraph. They read as lab specimens rather than portfolio thumbnails; nothing is captioned.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"work\",\n    \"description\": \"On white, the studio description sits in a narrow 250px mono column at far left, leaving three quarters of the row empty. A hand-drawn orange arrow sticker overlaps the mosaic's top-left corner, pointing in.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"faq\",\n    \"description\": \"Five stacked white pill-shaped rows in a centred column about 65% of the page wide, each with dark-red outline, hard offset shadow, question at left and chevron at right. Modules never alternate sides; they stack with large gaps.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"cta\",\n    \"description\": \"The closing block keeps the same narrow measure: a three-line paragraph at 13px, then the identical button and arrow-link pair from the hero, left-aligned on the text column's axis. Above it a bordered strip scrolls the email address in 44px italic uppercase, link parts in dotted-underline blue; below it a strip of sixteen evenly spaced dingbat glyphs ends in an arrow.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"work\",\n    \"description\": \"Left rail. At the bottom, a full-width outlined button with centred text.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"Right rail stacks four cells: a word that flips vertically between short apologies in 22px Times; a hairline analogue clock about 230px across with the city and digital time printed inside the face; a one-line temperature reading; and a tall navy cell where a pink illustrated flower sways, its stem cropped by the bottom edge.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Divide the viewport into bordered cells with 1px black lines and zero margin, and give each cell one live widget instead of a content section.\",\n   \"Contrast one enormous bitmap-style display word against otherwise completely unstyled default serif text.\",\n   \"Put a small working toy (a paint canvas, a random character generator) at the centre of a personal site so visitors make something before they read anything.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-medium-rare\",\n  \"name\": \"Medium Rare\",\n  \"url\": \"https://www.mediumrare.site\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"studio-portfolio\",\n  \"score\": 7.5,\n  \"idea\": \"A project index as a messy pile of coloured index cards, each slightly rotated and overlapping the last, stacked under a wordmark that fills the column.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"playful\",\n   \"punchy\",\n   \"handmade\",\n   \"bright\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"giant-wordmark\",\n  \"hero\": \"Warm off-white paper-textured page; all content sits in a 920px centred column. Each carries a 64px condensed title top-left and a faint mono number top-right.\",\n  \"type\": \"Oswald medium at 64px, mixed case, tracking -0.037em, for card titles; a heavier compressed grotesque for the wordmark (probably an image); Inter 14px for the small caps header and card subtitles; a mono for three-digit card numbers. Adjacent colours never repeat.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"contact\",\n    \"description\": \"After about 200px of empty paper, a single row: the wordmark at 30px tall on the left, a small-caps question in the middle, and a grey input with an outlined button on the right. Footer links run in small type along the bottom edge of the footage.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Open on an empty application window and type the headline into it, so the first screen demonstrates the product's premise instead of describing it.\",\n   \"Cut the corners of square media tiles at 45 degrees to give a plain video row its own silhouette.\",\n   \"Save all saturated colour for the final screen: a full-bleed close-up with one oversized quotation set over it.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-davesocozy\",\n  \"name\": \"davesocozy\",\n  \"url\": \"https://davesocozy.com\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"personal-portfolio\",\n  \"score\": 7.5,\n  \"idea\": \"A collage artist introduces himself by building a collage: each scroll step changes one caption and drops more paper cut-outs onto a green cutting mat.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"cozy\",\n   \"handmade\",\n   \"playful\",\n   \"warm\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"centred-statement-media-below\",\n  \"hero\": \"Cream page with a single centred object: a green cutting mat 776px wide by 582px tall (54% of viewport width), printed with a white grid, an inner border and diagonal guide lines, casting a soft shadow. Only two sizes, and the mono face gives a label-maker feel that suits a workbench.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#ede6d4 #5c894e #241a15 #3d2b22 #ffffff — Warm cream ground, mat green as the one large colour block, chocolate brown for text and buttons. Other colour arrives only through the collage scraps.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Cut-out vintage imagery (twin-lens camera, game console, microphone, globe, fox, fish, crumpled paper) and one portrait photo, each rotated a few degrees with a slight shadow, scattered on the mat like paper scraps. By the last caption the mat holds about ten scraps and a line of tiny uppercase instructions appears beneath the caption.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"After the intro the mat hands over to a canvas-rendered studio room that the visitor looks around with the mouse and clicks into (the page's own text lists a desk of collages, a wall of framed pieces and a television). The room itself is not in the captured frames, so its composition is unknown.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Pin one physical work surface in the centre and let scrolling add objects to it while a single caption line above changes, instead of stacking sections.\",\n   \"Put navigation in the four viewport corners as small tactile buttons so the centre stays free.\",\n   \"Rotate every cut-out by a different few degrees and give each a small shadow so flat images read as paper.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-nodeck\",\n  \"name\": \"Nodeck\",\n  \"url\": \"https://www.nodeck.online\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"agency\",\n  \"score\": 7.5,\n  \"idea\": \"A consultancy that claims to sell thinking rather than slides builds its site as a slide deck anyway, complete with prev/next buttons, a slide counter and presenter notes.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"cheeky\",\n   \"loud\",\n   \"pop\",\n   \"tactile\",\n   \"ironic\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"giant-wordmark\",\n  \"hero\": \"Flat bubblegum-pink viewport. Below, a horizontally running line of industry names in pale grey at about 1.5vw with two tiny mono tabs above it, then address blocks beside a small monochrome photo and a dot-matrix world map that echoes the hero globe.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Replace the horizontal nav bar with a vertical stack of links aligned to the headline's left edge, so nav and headline form one column.\",\n   \"Split a statement into grey lines and black lines instead of using bold or an accent colour for emphasis.\",\n   \"Stand cut-out machinery on the bottom edge of a white section so the dark band that follows becomes the ground.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-l-i-s-a\",\n  \"name\": \"L.I.S.A.\",\n  \"url\": \"https://lisa.locomotive.ca/en\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"agency\",\n  \"score\": 7.4,\n  \"idea\": \"The agency site is replaced by a conversation with a TV-headed 3D character whose CRT face draws expressions while she types to you.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"deadpan\",\n   \"retro-futurist\",\n   \"minimal\",\n   \"characterful\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"immersive-webgl\",\n  \"hero\": \"A grey studio backdrop with a soft radial light fills the viewport; the whole site is this one screen. Right of centre, a 3D bust in a lilac turtleneck wears a boxy CRT television for a head, cables looping around the neck; the figure is about 83% of viewport height, cropped at the chest by the bottom edge. The TV screen shows a changing glowing shape. At left mid-height, three lines of 26px regular grotesk in black are the only copy. Top-left: wordmark and a small star-like glyph; top-right: one text link. Bottom-right: a black capsule with two sound toggles. A thin progress bar sits on the bottom edge.\",\n  \"type\": \"HelveticaNowDisplay regular at one size, 26px, for wordmark, link and dialogue; earlier lines fade to pale grey and blur rather than shrinking. A block cursor follows typed text. Reply options are about 11px labels in white pills. No headline in the usual sense.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#979797 #c9c9c9 #000000 #cdbfd0 #3b5bff #ffffff — A mid-grey studio gradient with black text; the only colour is the lilac sweater, blue indicator lights on the TV and chromatic fringing in the CRT glow.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"One real-time 3D character: a CRT-television head with tangled cables on a mannequin torso, lit like a product shot on seamless grey. The screen displays brush-drawn white line faces, glitches and glowing eyes.\",\n  \"layout\": \"A single non-scrolling screen. Text column fixed at left mid-height, character fixed at right, small utilities in the four corners. Content changes in place as the dialogue advances; mobile moves the text into a white sheet with rounded top corners rising from the bottom edge.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"Same frame, next state: the greeting stays where it was but turns pale grey and slightly blurred, and a new three-line message types in directly below it in black at the same 26px size, ending in a solid block cursor. The TV face switches to a white brush-drawn glyph, two asterisks joined by an arc, that reads as squinting eyes. A small black circular restart button appears at bottom-left.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"cta\",\n    \"description\": \"When the message finishes, four small white pill buttons appear beneath it in two rows of two, left-aligned with the text, each roughly 110px wide with 11px labels, followed by a single line containing an underlined email address. The TV face changes to two large soft glowing circles as eyes. Nothing else enters; these pills are the entire navigation of the site.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Demote earlier lines of a conversation by fading and blurring them in place instead of scrolling them away, keeping one type size throughout.\",\n   \"Give a 3D mascot a screen for a face so expressions can be cheap 2D line drawings rather than rigged facial animation.\",\n   \"Offer navigation as three or four small reply pills that appear only after the character finishes speaking.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-risk\",\n  \"name\": \"RISK\",\n  \"url\": \"https://www.risk.film\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"studio-portfolio\",\n  \"score\": 7.4,\n  \"idea\": \"The site is a camera viewfinder: full-bleed film frames cut by glass-shard transitions, with credits, timecode and a small HUD laid over like on-monitor data.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"kinetic\",\n   \"cinematic\",\n   \"technical\",\n   \"daring\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"video-reel\",\n  \"hero\": \"Full-bleed film frame (an athlete mid-leap against teal sky beside a stone church), sliced by faint diagonal facets that offset parts of the image. At exact centre the wordmark, heavy italic extended capitals about 270px wide, is rendered as embossed refractive glass. All text is 9 to 13px uppercase cream: three nav words top-centre; client name at the mid-left edge and project title at the mid-right edge, level with the logo; director credit bottom-left; timecode bottom-right. Two dotted vertical hairlines divide the frame into thirds. Bottom-centre, a 295x95px outlined box split into cells holds a monogram, a motto, chevrons and line glyphs, with two links joined by a rule above.\",\n  \"type\": \"Syncopate bold, uppercase, slightly negative tracking, at just 9 to 13px for every label; Red Hat Display for the smallest credits. No text exceeds 0.9vw, so the only large letterforms are the glass logo. Effectively one size tier.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#2c5357 #776b45 #1d3a66 #c9a06f #e8e0cc #000000 — Colour is whatever the current film frame supplies (teal skies, sandstone, skin, deep blue) under a consistent filmic grade; overlay text and lines are a single warm cream.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Full-bleed commercial film footage: sport, close-up skin, domestic interiors; low angles, motion blur, teal-and-amber grade. Transitions break the frame into angular mirrored shards. No inset images.\",\n  \"layout\": \"One full-viewport frame per project in an endless vertical loop; overlay elements sit at fixed anchors (four corners, mid-left, mid-right, top-centre, bottom-centre) on a symmetric three-column guide. The layout never changes; only footage and labels swap.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"work\",\n    \"description\": \"Each project reuses the hero frame exactly: new footage fills the screen, the mid-left label changes to the client, the mid-right to the film title, bottom-left to the director, and the timecode keeps counting. The glass logo stays centred and picks up the colours of whatever is behind it, rust over skin or grey-white over an interior. The outlined HUD box and nav never move.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"Transition state. Between projects the image fractures into large triangular and parallelogram shards along 45-degree lines: some shards show the outgoing film, others the incoming one, slightly displaced and mirrored, so two frames coexist for a moment like light through a cut prism. The dotted verticals and cream labels stay perfectly still on top, which makes the overlay read as a fixed lens.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Overlay a film reel with fixed viewfinder data (credits at the edges, timecode in a corner, dotted third-lines) so project metadata feels like camera information.\",\n   \"Render the logo as transparent refractive glass over the footage so it takes its colour from every frame instead of having one.\",\n   \"Keep every overlay element at one tiny size and anchor each to a corner or edge midpoint, leaving the centre of the frame to the picture.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-proooof\",\n  \"name\": \"PROOOOF\",\n  \"url\": \"https://proooof.app\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"consumer-app\",\n  \"score\": 7.4,\n  \"idea\": \"The product's output is the page: a wall of photos each wearing its coloured EXIF strip, with all the copy folded into one small floating card.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"playful\",\n   \"photographic\",\n   \"compact\",\n   \"nerdy\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"other: floating-card-over-image-wall\",\n  \"hero\": \"The whole viewport is a six-column masonry of photographs on a warm off-white ground with about 15px gutters, columns offset vertically so rows never line up. Each photo has a flat strip fused to its bottom edge carrying tiny monospaced capture data, every strip a different solid colour (black, red, orange, yellow, violet, green). Dead centre floats a white card about 380px wide and 410px tall with roughly 28px corner radius and a soft shadow. It contains an extended wordmark with chained O's, a two-row accordion with the first row open, an App Store badge and a monospaced line of links. There is no navigation.\",\n  \"type\": \"An extended, heavy wordmark with interlocked O's is the only display type. Card text is Wintyr VF at about 14-16px, medium weight for accordion headings. EXIF strips and footer links are monospace at roughly 8-13px. No headline anywhere.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#f3eee9 #fafafa #191818 #ff6a2b #f7c531 #5a4fcf — Colour comes from the photographs and the saturated caption strips, one hue per photo. Card and gutters stay off-white; a final panel flips to near-black with grey characters.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Casual travel, food, pet and concert photos in mixed portrait and landscape crops, square corners, ungraded, tiled edge to edge. The page ends on an ASCII-art rendering of a hand holding a camera.\",\n  \"layout\": \"Effectively a single screen: the photo wall sits behind a centred card that carries every word. Six columns on desktop, two on mobile where the card widens to nearly full width. The only second scene is a dark, inset ASCII panel.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"features\",\n    \"description\": \"All product copy lives in the centred card as an accordion: a row with heading left and chevron right, a hairline divider, the open panel's four-line paragraph, a centred store badge, another divider, a collapsed second row, then a small monospaced line with a version number and underlined links. The card stays put while the wall remains visible on all four sides.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"gallery\",\n    \"description\": \"Each tile is a photo with a data strip attached below: two or three rows of monospaced text, four values spread evenly across the first row, date and time at opposite ends of the second, maker and model on the third. Strip and text colours change per tile, for example yellow on black, black on yellow, white on violet, so a uniform grid looks varied.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"cta\",\n    \"description\": \"The closing panel is a near-black rectangle inset with wide margins and filled edge to edge with rows of grey ASCII characters that resolve into a picture of a hand gripping a camera. One line of tiny monospaced uppercase text sits at the exact centre as the call to action. No button and no logo.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Show the product's output at wall scale as the background and confine all copy to one small card on top of it.\",\n   \"Give every repeated tile its own flat accent colour for the caption strip so a strict grid reads as lively.\",\n   \"Hold the explanatory copy in an accordion inside the hero card so the page needs no scrolling.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-artem-shcherbakov\",\n  \"name\": \"Artem Shcherbakov\",\n  \"url\": \"https://artemartemartem.com/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"personal-portfolio\",\n  \"score\": 7.4,\n  \"idea\": \"A director's reel hides behind a small pill-shaped window that scrolls open to fill the screen, while neon-green marker scribbles deface the polite typography.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"irreverent\",\n   \"raw\",\n   \"playful\",\n   \"lo-fi\",\n   \"energetic\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"other: three-part-row-with-video-portal\",\n  \"hero\": \"White page. Three nav words are pinned to the very top: one hard left, the name centred, one hard right, in bold condensed lowercase about 28px, touching the edges. The content is a single horizontal row at mid-height in three equal parts. Left: a two-line greeting in an ultra-heavy rounded sans at about 6vw, with a neon-green hand-scrawled word and underline drawn over it. Centre: a vertical rounded-rectangle window about 180 by 300px showing zoomed, pixelated video. Right: a green doodle face above a centred six-line bio at about 22px. A tiny grey scroll cue sits bottom-centre. More than 60% is white.\",\n  \"type\": \"EaseDouble at weight 900 with -0.08em tracking, letters nearly fused, for display; plain Arial Narrow for nav and body, bold in the nav. About 88px display against roughly 22px body. Display type melts into soft blobs between states.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#ffffff #0e0e0e #17e84a #ff2ecb — Black on white, inverting to white on near-black for the footer. One neon green is reserved for hand-drawn scribbles and doodles, with a single touch of magenta.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"CG character footage treated with scanlines, colour fringing and heavy pixelation, shown first inside a small pill mask and then full-bleed. Crude marker doodles (faces, robot, clapperboard) in green outline are scattered around it.\",\n  \"layout\": \"A short single-scroll sequence: three-part intro row, full-bleed video with a stacked project list, a centred paragraph in display type, a dark contact panel. Nav words stay in the top corners throughout. No grid lines, no cards, no section headings.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"work\",\n    \"description\": \"The video fills the viewport edge to edge. Project names are stacked bottom-left in the heavy rounded face at about 5vw, lowercase with tight leading, in translucent white so footage shows through; the active name turns solid white and gets a green scribble across it. The list runs off the bottom edge. In a later state the video shrinks to a rounded rectangle about two-thirds of the viewport wide.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"A centred five-line paragraph set entirely in the 900-weight rounded display face at about 4.5vw on white, tracked so tightly the letters touch. The last line is caught mid-reveal as soft black blobs, showing that each line condenses from a blurred, gooey state into legible type.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"contact\",\n    \"description\": \"Near-black panel. A two-line centred heading in white display type sits at the top with green and magenta scribbles over a few letters. Below, a narrow centred column lists contact details in small plain sans, each preceded by a tiny grey label. Five or six green line doodles are scattered around the edges, some cropped by the viewport.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Start the showreel as a small pill-shaped mask in the hero and let scrolling grow it to full-bleed.\",\n   \"Overdraw clean display type with a single-colour hand scribble to add personality without a second typeface.\",\n   \"Pair one extravagant display face with a deliberately default system face (Arial Narrow) for everything functional.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-builders-table\",\n  \"name\": \"Builders Table\",\n  \"url\": \"https://builderstable.net\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"event\",\n  \"score\": 7.4,\n  \"idea\": \"A conference page laid out like a creative-coding workspace: generative canvases sit on a dot grid inside selection boxes with file-name tags and a live control panel.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"technical\",\n   \"energetic\",\n   \"dark\",\n   \"tool-like\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"other: left-statement-over-scattered-canvas-frames\",\n  \"hero\": \"Charcoal page with a faint dot grid. A hairline-underlined tab bar with two text tabs runs across the top. Next row: stacked-caps wordmark at the 40px left margin, date and venue in two grey lines at 55% with a small lime square bullet, a lime rectangular button far right. The headline is two lines of uppercase grotesk at about 5.5vw, left-aligned, first line white, second mid-grey, followed by a two-line grey paragraph and two buttons. The lower 40% holds four outlined canvases at different sizes and heights, each with white corner handles and a tiny coloured mono tag: a plus-sign field, green smoke, a cyan dot-matrix portrait, a slider panel.\",\n  \"type\": \"Laygrotesk at weight 400 for everything: uppercase headlines between 5.5vw and 7vw with very tight leading and a white/grey split per line, 20px body with a tight letterfit, plus tiny mono caps for file tags, label rows and footer links.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#111111 #ffffff #dafa9c #000000 #5fb6d9 #8f8f8f — Charcoal hero, white middle sections, black footer. Pale lime is the single action colour on every button and tag; cyan, magenta and green appear only inside the generative canvases.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Shader and dither canvases: grids of plus signs, green noise clouds, portraits rebuilt from coloured dots. Framed with one-pixel outlines, square corner handles and file-name labels, as if selected in a design tool.\",\n  \"layout\": \"40px margins, everything hung from the left edge. Dark hero with scattered frames, then orderly white sections, each opened by a three-part mono label row over a hairline and a two-line two-tone heading; schedule and speaker lists use a sidebar-plus-rows structure.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"features\",\n    \"description\": \"Three equal dark tiles in a row, about 310px tall with 8px gaps, each filled with a different generative texture (plus-sign grid, magenta dither, blurred blue-grey bars). Each carries three lines of small white text anchored bottom-left with 16px padding. No icons or headings: the texture is the differentiator. The row sits directly under a white intro block with a large left paragraph and small right paragraph.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"list\",\n    \"description\": \"A label row of three tiny mono words (left, centre, right) over a hairline, then a two-line uppercase heading, first line grey, second black, with a lime button on the same row at far right. Below: a 130px left column of two stacked day tabs, the active one black, and a right column of pale-grey rows, each with time at 20px, a small grey meta line, the title in a second column and overlapping round avatars far right.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"A black panel set over the last strip of dot grid, with canvas frames peeking above it. Top-left a short-form wordmark with the year at about 6vw; top-right a three-row accordion with bracketed mono numbers, 20px labels and plus signs, separated by hairlines. Bottom-left a two-line tagline; bottom-right a column of tiny mono legal links; a final mono caps line spans the base.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Frame generative visuals with selection handles and a tiny file-name tag so decoration reads as work in progress.\",\n   \"Split a two-line uppercase headline into two tones, one line full strength and one grey, instead of changing size or weight.\",\n   \"Replace icon feature cards with tiles whose only differentiator is a distinct generative texture, text pinned bottom-left.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-nothin\",\n  \"name\": \"NOTHIN’\",\n  \"url\": \"https://www.noth.in\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"agency\",\n  \"score\": 7.4,\n  \"idea\": \"The studio's name set as a wordmark so large it is the whole hero, repeated in inverted colours as the footer, so 'nothing' is literally the only content on screen.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"stark\",\n   \"confident\",\n   \"minimal\",\n   \"wry\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"giant-wordmark\",\n  \"hero\": \"The captured hero frame is a black preloader wipe; this describes the loaded state. White field. A custom heavy geometric wordmark in black spans the full width between 1% margins, vertically centred, about 30% of the viewport tall, its apostrophe hanging at the top-right. Top-left: a two-line statement at about 1.6vw with a small black pill button under it. Top-right: a tiny menu label with a four-dot icon. Along the bottom edge: a one-line studio descriptor at left, two social links and a language chip at right. Everything else is empty white, with no image and no colour.\",\n  \"type\": \"PP Neue Montreal medium for statements at up to about 5vw, sentence case, tight tracking and leading; the Book cut for small text; IBM Plex Mono for tiny grey project labels. The wordmark is custom heavy geometric lettering at close to 100vw. Only three text sizes: statement, caption, micro-label.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#ffffff #000000 #2b47e6 #2f5d33 #bfbfbf — Strict black and white that flips by section: white hero and intro, black works and footer. The only colour comes from inside the imagery, chiefly electric-blue foil and fern green.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"3D renders of inflated chrome, crumpled blue foil and bubble-wrap hearts on black; project shots are brand mock-ups photographed in settings (a card among ferns, a laptop on a dark desk). Hard-edged rectangles of varied size, square corners.\",\n  \"layout\": \"Margins of about 1%, so content runs nearly edge to edge. The intro is a left headline over a full-width black media panel; the works section places images at irregular widths and horizontal offsets with wide black gaps, each with a mono label and one-line caption above.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"White section. A two-line statement at about 5vw sits flush left under a small logo mark, filling the top quarter. Below it a black rectangle spans the full content width and runs off the bottom of the viewport, holding a 3D still life clustered at centre. On further scroll the panel shrinks to a small thumbnail docked top-right, while a parenthesised label and a four-line paragraph at caption size appear in two narrow columns at the left.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"work\",\n    \"description\": \"Black section headed by one bold uppercase word top-left. Project images are placed as a loose scatter: one at about 48% width hugging the left margin, the next narrow and hugging the right margin lower down, the next inset to start 18% across. Above each image sits a tiny grey mono project name, then a one-line white caption at about 1.1vw. A two-line aphorism floats alone at the right between projects. Long stretches of empty black separate items.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"Black, full viewport. A two-line invitation at about 5vw at the left in the upper third, with two outlined pill buttons under it; three social links stacked at about 78% across. The wordmark repeats in white at full width, anchored to the bottom, with a single row of micro-text credits beneath it.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Make the hero nothing but the name: a wordmark scaled to the full viewport width on a blank field, with only a two-line statement and one small button in a corner.\",\n   \"Repeat the hero wordmark in inverted colours as the footer so the page opens and closes on the same shape.\",\n   \"Place case-study images at different widths and horizontal offsets on a black field, each with a micro mono label and a single-line caption above it instead of a card.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-superlocal-2026\",\n  \"name\": \"Superlocal 2026\",\n  \"url\": \"https://www.superlocaldesign.com/\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"event\",\n  \"score\": 7.4,\n  \"idea\": \"Everything is a circle: a dot-matrix logotype whose dots become floating photo circles and glowing orbs across a grey-to-orange field.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"playful\",\n   \"experimental\",\n   \"warm\",\n   \"kinetic\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"immersive-webgl\",\n  \"hero\": \"Mid-grey field with a faint dot grid (one dot every 33px) that fades through the lower half into saturated orange at the bottom edge. The captured first paint contains one element: a 270×80px logotype dead centre, built from black ellipses of varying size, its letters progressively compressed to the right. No nav or text yet. After loading, a cluster of four small pills (one black, three white) appears top-centre; the logo turns white inside a 330px ring of about fifty tiny circles — round photo crops, glowing orbs, coins; and the bottom edge carries the event name left and dates right in an outlined dot-matrix face 40px tall.\",\n  \"type\": \"Display text is an outlined dot-matrix face drawn on canvas, about 40px caps, modules flickering. All other text is one tight bold grotesk ('fontSans') from 12 to 24px with negative tracking. The logotype is built from ellipses on the same matrix.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#bcbcbc #ff641e #1a1302 #ffb740 #c13bff #ffffff — Every screen repeats a vertical fade from flat grey to hot orange. Orbs add magenta-violet cores; the footer swaps to a soft yellow glow. Text is near-black, nav pills black and white.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Event photographs cropped to circles from 60 to 240px, floating without a grid alongside hard-edged radial-gradient orbs and coin images; some pairs overlap. The logo and footer art are generated dot matrices.\",\n  \"layout\": \"No visible grid: circles drift across each screen while text locks to the bottom corners (statement bottom-left, description bottom-right). A four-pill nav stays top-centre. The footer resolves into three text columns over a screen-filling dot-matrix glow.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"gallery\",\n    \"description\": \"No grid. Circular photo crops between 60 and 240px across float over the grey-to-orange field, a few overlapping in pairs. A flat radial orb (orange rim, magenta-violet core, about 160px) sits among them and others are cut by the viewport edges. The pill nav stays top-centre; nothing else is fixed.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"Bottom-left: a small bold date line, then a two-line statement in the outlined dot-matrix face at about 36px, some modules lit orange mid-animation. Bottom-right: a two-line 12px bold description. Above them three photo circles (190px portrait near centre, poster collage left, stage shot right) and a large orb top-right.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"Grey field with a huge soft yellow radial glow. The dot-matrix logo is enlarged to fill the screen, its ellipses knocked out of the yellow in grey. On top: three columns of bold 18px text (contact message and email left, press list centre, socials right), a tiny credits list, and a bottom line with dates, year and city in the same three columns.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Build the logotype from a dot matrix of ellipses of varying size, then reuse the same matrix at screen-filling scale as the footer background.\",\n   \"Crop every photo to a circle at wildly different diameters and let them float with coloured orbs instead of sitting in a gallery grid.\",\n   \"Fade each screen from flat grey into one saturated colour at its bottom edge so the viewport itself carries the brand colour.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-produx-design\",\n  \"name\": \"Produx Design\",\n  \"url\": \"https://www.produx.design\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"agency\",\n  \"score\": 7.4,\n  \"idea\": \"The wordmark is the hero, and the showreel image assembles itself from scattered square fragments as you scroll.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"dark\",\n   \"confident\",\n   \"technical\",\n   \"spare\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"giant-wordmark\",\n  \"hero\": \"Near-black field with 80px side margins. A large empty gap follows. In the lower half a two-line statement at 5.1vw sits flush left; opposite it, bottom-aligned to the statement and flush to the right margin, is a three-line paragraph in small monospace about a quarter of the width. No nav bar, button or image in the first viewport; the bottom quarter is empty.\",\n  \"type\": \"At Aero in light-to-medium weight for the wordmark, the 74px statement and project titles; DM Mono for the hero paragraph, bracketed nav items and uppercase project blurbs at about 11px. Colour arrives only through imagery: moss green and sage in the showreel render, then each case-study thumbnail brings its own palette.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"A 3D render of a moss-covered boulder on a sage background, first broken into scattered square tiles, then whole as a 16:9 inset. After the hero, a small logo top-left and four bracketed mono links spread across the right half. Hero is all type, the next three screens are a pinned image assembly, then a work grid with unequal column widths and mono captions under each thumbnail.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"Pinned showreel reveal on black. Eight to ten small square tiles, 60 to 100px, each a different crop of the same image, float scattered around the centre at different depths, some blurred. As scroll advances they multiply, enlarge and lock together until they form one 16:9 image inset at about 70% of viewport width, with the wordmark centred on it in white and tiny captions overlaid at left and lower right.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"work\",\n    \"description\": \"Two unequal columns on black, roughly 52% and 30% of the width with a wide gutter. Each item is a square-cornered thumbnail with a row of small rectangular mono tags along its bottom edge; beneath it a small square bullet, the project name in the sans at about 16px and a two-line uppercase mono blurb. The next item breaks the grid: a single thumbnail centred at about 75% width.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Run the wordmark margin to margin in a light weight rather than a heavy one; thin strokes at huge size read as assured instead of loud.\",\n   \"Pair one large sans statement with a tiny monospace paragraph bottom-aligned on the opposite margin and leave the middle of the row empty.\",\n   \"Introduce the hero image as scattered square crops of itself that converge into the full frame on scroll.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-kononenko-architectural-bureau\",\n  \"name\": \"Kononenko Architectural Bureau\",\n  \"url\": \"https://kononenkogroup.com\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"architecture\",\n  \"score\": 7.4,\n  \"idea\": \"Let the renders do the talking: one full-bleed visualisation, a name set half in grotesk and half in serif, then alternating oversized sans and serif statements on white.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"calm\",\n   \"rational\",\n   \"refined\",\n   \"spacious\",\n   \"cool\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"fullbleed-media-overlay\",\n  \"hero\": \"A single architectural render fills the viewport edge to edge: a low grey metal-clad building under a large overcast sky, wild grass across the bottom third. Type is white and tiny except for the name. Top-left at a 24px margin, the bureau name is stacked on three lines at 13px. Top-right, four links run inline separated by commas, the current one underlined. Bottom-left, the name repeats at 60px (4.2vw) on two tight lines, the first two words in grotesk and the last word in a serif at the same size. No button, no scrim, no tagline; the sky takes the upper 45% untouched.\",\n  \"type\": \"Two faces (digest names are obfuscated): a tight neo-grotesk at −0.03em and a soft high-contrast serif, mixed inside one line in the name. Section statements alternate: centred sans at about 6.5vw, then left-aligned serif at 4.5vw with a first-line indent. Labels are 9px.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#ffffff #000000 #b7b7b9 #7c8050 #3d3a36 #9a9a9a — White pages with black type; colour comes only from the renders' overcast greys, greens and dark timber. The footer inverts to solid black with white letters.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Photoreal architectural visualisations in muted natural light, shown full-bleed at wide panoramic crops with square corners and no overlays; one loose black ink sketch on white stands in for process.\",\n  \"layout\": \"24px outer margins. Full-bleed image bands alternate with white type-only screens. Big statements either centre or run the full width; small data sits in narrow columns with tiny serif labels left of sans values, and hairline tables are inset to the right-hand third.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"White screen with a two-line sans heading centred at roughly 6.5vw, tight leading, taking the top third. Directly beneath, two tiny grey captions of two lines each sit side by side, each about 130px wide, centred as a pair. A full-bleed panoramic render starts immediately below and runs off the bottom, so the heading reads as a caption to the picture.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"about\",\n    \"description\": \"Far left, three label and value pairs at 9px (serif label, sans value) stack in a 150px column. From 34% across, a five-line serif paragraph at about 22px runs to 90% of the width. 120px lower a second row repeats the logic for achievements: a label at far left, then two narrow list columns of awards and publications at 9px with generous gaps between them.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"list\",\n    \"description\": \"A four-line serif statement at 4.5vw spans the full width, left-aligned with the first line indented about 3% and leading under 1. Below it, pushed into the right-hand 35% of the page, an offices table: a tiny label hangs to its left, and each row holds office type, country and city in grey, an address, and a small arrow, divided by hairlines at 18px row height.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"Solid black. A top band of five tiny columns (name, navigation, media, address, hours), each a grey label beside a white list. Then a four-letter abbreviation of the name in white grotesk fills the entire width, letters about 45% of the viewport tall and touching both edges, with a single 8px legal line squeezed beneath.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Set the last word of a sans headline in an upright serif of the same size to give a plain name a signature without any graphic device.\",\n   \"Alternate statement voices down the page: a centred grotesk heading, then a full-width left-aligned serif paragraph at display size with a first-line indent.\",\n   \"Close with an abbreviation of the name scaled until it touches both edges of a black footer, with all practical links shrunk to 9px above it.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-studio-k95-3\",\n  \"name\": \"Studio K95\",\n  \"url\": \"https://k95.it\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"studio-portfolio\",\n  \"score\": 7.4,\n  \"idea\": \"The whole portfolio is one WebGL room: project images orbit in rings around a chrome voxel rose inside an electric-blue gridded cylinder.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"electric\",\n   \"playful\",\n   \"spatial\",\n   \"bold\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"immersive-webgl\",\n  \"hero\": \"A saturated ultramarine field covers the viewport, drawn with a faint dark grid that curves as if seen from inside a cylinder. Interface text is tiny and pinned to the edges with 58px margins: logo top left, a pill layout toggle top centre, three caps links and a language switch top right; a discipline line, a works counter and the year along the bottom.\",\n  \"type\": \"One wide-set grotesk ('adaptive' in the digest) at a single small size, roughly 14 to 16px, bold, caps for nav and labels. No display headline is shown; the digest's 32px heading is not visible. The blocky geometric logo is the only large letterform.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#0800b7 #1500e1 #c8ccd4 #ffffff #e9e34a #e23a28 — One electric blue fills everything; white type and chrome geometry sit on it, and every other colour arrives through the project thumbnails. A single yellow dot marks the cursor.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Project stills (posters, packaging, furniture, brand marks) as square-cornered portrait planes in 3D perspective, uncropped and ungraded, plus a reflective chrome voxel rose as the centre object.\",\n  \"layout\": \"A single non-scrolling screen. Content lives in 3D space while a thin heads-up frame holds three items across the top and three across the bottom, with nothing between them but the canvas. Scrolling rotates the scene rather than moving the page.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"work\",\n    \"description\": \"The index is the scene itself. A segmented pill at top centre switches the arrangement between rings and a spiral.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"There is no footer block, only a single baseline 30px above the bottom edge carrying three items in the same small bold type: the studio's discipline flush left, a counter of shown versus total projects at centre with one underlined word linking to the full list, and the copyright year flush right. Thumbnails pass behind this line as the scene turns.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Let a single saturated colour field be the whole page and take every other colour from the work thumbnails.\",\n   \"Offer two named arrangements of the same index through a small segmented toggle, so the layout itself becomes a control.\",\n   \"Keep interface text to one small size pinned at the corners and centre edges, including a live count of shown versus total projects.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-julien-calot\",\n  \"name\": \"Julien Calot\",\n  \"url\": \"https://www.juliencalot.com\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"personal-portfolio\",\n  \"score\": 7.4,\n  \"idea\": \"Each series of paintings is a full-screen close crop of one canvas, with the series title, year and piece count strung along a single line at mid-height like a museum wall label.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"vivid\",\n   \"immersive\",\n   \"naive\",\n   \"gallery-like\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"fullbleed-media-overlay\",\n  \"hero\": \"A painting detail fills the viewport edge to edge, a face in the centre with saturated landscape shapes around it and the canvas weave visible. On the vertical midline a single row reads: year at the far left, series title in condensed black caps at 1.6vw about 10% in, and a piece count preceded by a short dash at the far right. No button.\",\n  \"type\": \"FF DIN Pro Condensed Black in uppercase with +0.02em tracking for the wordmark and series titles (23px); Doner, a wide bold sans, for tiny uppercase nav and meta at about 9-10px. The single-series view switches to flat light grey.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Photographed paintings in a saturated naive style, used two ways: enormous full-bleed crops showing brushwork and weave, and small complete canvases with linen edges and soft drop shadows in a horizontal row on grey.\",\n  \"layout\": \"A stack of full-viewport panels, one per series, identical in structure: fixed header along the top, one label row at mid-height, nothing else. The fixed header overlays all of them unchanged, so scrolling reads like turning plates in a book.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"gallery\",\n    \"description\": \"Flat light-grey viewport. About 70% of the screen is empty grey.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Crop artwork far past its edges to fill the screen and keep all text under 2vw, so the image does the shouting and the type behaves like a wall label.\",\n   \"Run a panel's metadata along one horizontal line at mid-height: date at the far left, title a tenth in, count at the far right, repeated identically on every panel.\",\n   \"Contrast full-bleed immersion with a sparse detail view: tiny complete works in a single row on flat grey with 70% of the screen left empty.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-cominvi\",\n  \"name\": \"CoMinVi\",\n  \"url\": \"https://www.cominvi.com.mx/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"other\",\n  \"score\": 7.3,\n  \"idea\": \"A heavy-industry contractor presented with a cinematic CG mine scene and survey-style monospace annotations, then a clean white corporate report beneath.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"industrial\",\n   \"cinematic\",\n   \"sober\",\n   \"precise\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"fullbleed-media-overlay\",\n  \"hero\": \"Full-bleed dark blue-black CG scene of an underground cavern: rock in the foreground, haze, and a mining truck with lit headlamps right of centre. The footer is a single line at the very bottom: social link left, copyright centre, three underlined utility links right, with a tall empty gap above.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Size the wordmark to fill the content width exactly and let the first photograph tuck directly under its baseline.\",\n   \"Draw a location map as a tone-on-tone silhouette with one filled dot among ring dots.\",\n   \"Use a single typeface in one weight and essentially one text size, creating hierarchy through placement and emptiness.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-normal-is-boring\",\n  \"name\": \"NORMAL IS BORING\",\n  \"url\": \"https://normalisboring.es/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"real-estate\",\n  \"score\": 7.3,\n  \"idea\": \"The brand name is split and half of it turned upside down: a plain sans first word top-left and a serif last word flipped 180 degrees bottom-right stay fixed while panels slide sideways between them.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"refined\",\n   \"playful\",\n   \"warm\",\n   \"editorial\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"split-text-media\",\n  \"hero\": \"A white panel fills the left 80%; a full-height interior photo takes the right 20%. A boxed strip at the bottom repeats the design credit as a mono marquee.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Split a two-line headline around a centred cut-out object so the words frame it left and right and the object reads as part of the sentence.\",\n   \"Carry a fiction through the interface chrome: header as agency letterhead, sections as case-file panels, status labels and dashed warning boxes in place of marketing copy.\",\n   \"Use faint wandering footprint trails as the only decoration on an otherwise empty dark section.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-alterg-resources\",\n  \"name\": \"AlterG Resources\",\n  \"url\": \"https://altergresources.com\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"other\",\n  \"score\": 7,\n  \"idea\": \"A corporate energy site organised by visible blueprint guide lines, with the logo's trapezoid-and-arch geometry reused as frosted facets over landscape photos and as repeat-pattern bands.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"corporate\",\n   \"calm\",\n   \"clean\",\n   \"earthy\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"centred-statement-media-below\",\n  \"hero\": \"White page with pale-blue vertical guide lines about 30px inside each edge and a horizontal hairline under the 74px header. At left, the client name in white semibold, on some rows followed by an outlined pill naming an award count. At right, a pale site link with a north-east arrow; where the site is offline the link is struck through rather than removed, so the list keeps its full length.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"testimonial\",\n    \"description\": \"A two-cell row divided by vertical hairlines. Each cell holds a long quote in 13px white, then the author's name and title bottom-left and the company logo bottom-right in pale blue. The second cell is cut off by the column edge to signal horizontal scrolling; two small arrow buttons sit in bordered squares underneath at the left.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"A strip labelled in tiny tracked caps with an external link at its right end, then six portrait film posters in a row, all converted to blue-and-white monotone with a thin lighter border. Under each poster: a truncated title, the year and a five-star rating in about 10px. A final hairline row carries the year at left and a social handle at right.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Flood the page with one saturated colour and recolour every image as a monotone of it so nothing breaks the field.\",\n   \"Strike through dead links instead of deleting them; it shows history honestly and adds texture to a list.\",\n   \"Add small live data strips (local time, weather, now playing, recently watched) to make a text-only profile feel inhabited.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-near\",\n  \"name\": \"near\",\n  \"url\": \"https://near.com\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"finance\",\n  \"score\": 6.9,\n  \"idea\": \"Show the real account dashboard immediately under a plain promise; there is no visual idea beyond a mint glow and a ruled page frame.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"clean\",\n   \"calm\",\n   \"corporate\",\n   \"trustworthy\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"app-ui-showcase\",\n  \"hero\": \"White page framed by two hairline vertical rules 80px in from each side. Under it a two-line grey 18px sub, then a black rounded button with a grey reassurance line beside it. The right half of the upper hero is empty. At 60% down a green-dot demo label, then a dashboard screenshot with a thick dark rounded bezel spans the full frame width and is cropped by the fold. A mint-green glow rises behind it from the bottom corners.\",\n  \"type\": \"Figtree only. Headline 500 weight at 60px with -0.025em tracking; section heads drop to about 36px; body 14 to 18px in grey. A modest 4:1 jump, sentence case throughout, no caps labels.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#ffffff #262626 #00ec97 #171717 #eaeaea — White and charcoal sections alternate. Mint green is the one accent, used as large gradient fields behind UI widgets, in the closing band and on small icons. Cool overall.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Live-looking dashboard and swap widgets in dark and white rounded panels, placed on mint gradient blocks, plus a row of round crypto coin logos. No photography or illustration.\",\n  \"layout\": \"Everything sits inside a 1280px frame drawn with hairline verticals; sections are divided into ruled cells, with bands of a faint plus-sign pattern as spacers. A left-aligned heading plus sub opens every section. White, dark, white, mint rhythm.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"features\",\n    \"description\": \"Inside the ruled frame: heading and one-line sub top-left, then a two-column block. The left column is a vertical list of six feature titles separated by hairlines; the open one has a pale grey fill and a three-line description, and two carry small green status text. The right column is a flat mint-green panel the full height of the list with a dark rounded swap widget floating in it.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"stats\",\n    \"description\": \"Charcoal band divided by hairlines into three equal cells aligned to the page frame. Each cell holds a 28px white numeral top-left with a tiny grey caption under it and a lot of empty cell around. Directly beneath runs a full-width strip of faint plus signs on the same charcoal, a textured spacer before the page returns to white.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"cta\",\n    \"description\": \"A mint-green band fading lighter toward the top holds a left-aligned 32px heading, one line of dark sub and a black rounded button, all in the left third. It bleeds into a charcoal footer: logo and two-line description left, three short link columns right, and the wordmark repeated enormous and barely lighter than the background across the bottom.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Draw the page container as two visible hairline verticals and align every cell divider to them, so the grid itself is the decoration.\",\n   \"Put a short grey reassurance sentence inline to the right of the primary button instead of a second button.\",\n   \"Use a strip of faint plus-sign pattern as a spacer band between sections in place of empty padding.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-trionn-2\",\n  \"name\": \"TRIONN\",\n  \"url\": \"https://trionn.com\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"agency\",\n  \"score\": 6.8,\n  \"idea\": \"A dark WebGL stage where the studio's angular logo floats as a wireframe among black shards the visitor can blast; the copy is secondary to the toy.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"dark\",\n   \"technical\",\n   \"sleek\",\n   \"showy\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"immersive-webgl\",\n  \"hero\": \"Near-black canvas with dark angular shards drifting and a wireframe 3D logo mark, about 30% of the width, floating at centre in barely lighter grey. The headline sits flush left directly under the logo: two lines of light-grey grotesk at 6.3vw with -0.06em tracking, reaching 42% across. Bottom-right, a 235px-wide block: a hairline-bordered two-cell box (globe icon with founding year, a two-line uppercase claim) above three lines of 16px copy. Bottom-centre, two lines of tiny uppercase instructions with emoji. Bottom-left, a small circle scroll cue.\",\n  \"type\": \"Familjen Grotesk regular at 90px with very tight -0.06em tracking for headlines, rising to about 9vw capitals in the marquee; Neue Haas at 16px for copy; Martian Mono in tiny capitals for link labels. One section flips to light grey through horizontal bars.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Real-time 3D: the logo as extruded wireframe and solid black slabs, scattered shards and thin streak lines in very low contrast; later a tilted semi-transparent card with a project image floating on a pale gradient.\",\n  \"layout\": \"Full-bleed stage with 36px margins. Twenty-eight screens of pinned scenes, a full-width marquee, a light interlude, then a dark footer.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"A four-line statement at about 4.5vw starts 55% across the screen with a first-line indent of roughly 60px, in pale grey that fills in word by word from dim to bright. A tiny uppercase section label sits alone at the far left on the first line's height. Beneath, two small captions at opposite ends of the text block: a three-line uppercase motto left, a three-line sentence right, then an underlined mono link.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"Marquee and wipe. A single line of capitals at about 9vw crosses the full width and runs off both edges, words separated by small plus signs with wide gaps; the 3D logo slab stands behind it and a glowing orange facet pokes between two words. The line becomes the seam of a transition: stacked horizontal pale-grey bars of varying thickness sweep up the screen and invert the page to light.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"stats\",\n    \"description\": \"Light-grey gradient screen, empty except for a centred two-word heading near 40px in dark grey with two tiny centred lines beneath, placed in the lower middle. Below and left, a tilted semi-transparent card carrying a project image floats in perspective as it enters from the bottom edge. The nav pills invert to dark for this section.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"Dark again. Top-left a tiny uppercase line, then a two-line 40px question. Right column: two mono uppercase link rows, each on its own hairline with an arrow at the end, then contact and social in small two-column lists. The bottom third is the wordmark at full width, drawn only from horizontal scanlines of varying length so it reads as a faint striped ghost.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Pin small supporting blocks to the viewport corners (a bordered two-cell fact box bottom-right, an instruction bottom-centre) so the headline can sit alone top-left.\",\n   \"Indent the first line of a large statement and start the block right of centre, leaving a tiny section label alone at the far margin.\",\n   \"Draw the footer wordmark from horizontal scanlines of varying length instead of solid letters.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-flowjam-2\",\n  \"name\": \"Flowjam\",\n  \"url\": \"https://flowjam.com\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"agency\",\n  \"score\": 6.8,\n  \"idea\": \"A persistent frosted sidebar card holds the pitch and buttons while a soft-serif content column scrolls past it; beyond that there is no idea stronger than proof by logos and videos.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"soft\",\n   \"friendly\",\n   \"grainy\",\n   \"startup\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"other: sticky-sidebar-statement\",\n  \"hero\": \"Grainy off-white page. A tall rounded card about 26% of the viewport wide is pinned at the left and runs off the bottom; frosted over blurred pink and yellow flowers, it holds the logo, a two-line serif tagline, a short blurb and two pill buttons in hot pink and charcoal. The main column starts 32% from the left: a hot-pink pill badge, a three-line serif headline at 4.2vw, then a paragraph whose first sentence is grey and the rest black. A lone charcoal pill button floats far right at mid-height. Below: a heart icon with a proof line, then the top of a four-column logo grid with dotted borders.\",\n  \"type\": \"Gelica throughout: a soft, slightly bulbous serif at regular weight, 60px headline with tight -0.05em tracking, 16 to 19px body, down to about 9px in the sidebar.
