The footer flips to black.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Rounded-corner video thumbnails of founders talking to camera and product UI clips, each with a small round play button bottom-left; monochrome client logos in a dotted-line grid; blurred floral blobs behind the frosted sidebar.\",\n  \"layout\": \"A fixed 26% sidebar card at left for the whole scroll; content occupies one column to its right, split into two for video tiles and four for logos. Sections are separated by whitespace only. The footer is a rounded black panel that still leaves the sidebar in place.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"proof\",\n    \"description\": \"Four-column grid of client logos drawn with faint dotted cell borders, each cell roughly 240px wide and 115px tall with the logo centred in dark grey monochrome. Sixteen or more logos over four rows, no captions. Above it, a centred line with a purple heart glyph and a sentence whose first word is black and the rest grey serves as the heading.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"work\",\n    \"description\": \"Two-column grid of video cards. Each card has a header row with the client name in 14px serif and a one-line result in tiny grey beneath it at left, and a small outlined pill link at right; then a 16:9 thumbnail with about 10px radius and a round play button over its bottom-left corner. Cards are divided by hairlines rather than boxes, and some thumbnails are flat type frames instead of photos.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"A rounded black panel inset from the page edges, sitting right of the sidebar. Its background is a short phrase repeated in dark-grey serif at about 5vw, rows offset so the words tile like wallpaper. Centred over it: a two-line white serif headline at about 2.5vw and a small stat line. The lower third holds the logo at left and four narrow columns of tiny text.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Pin a narrow card with logo, one-line pitch and both actions beside the scrolling content, so the call to action never leaves the screen and no top nav is needed.\",\n   \"Set one sentence of a paragraph in grey and the rest in black to rank two claims without changing size or weight.\",\n   \"Tile a short phrase as dark-on-black wallpaper behind the footer headline.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-the-watch\",\n  \"name\": \"The Watch\",\n  \"url\": \"https://thewatch.60fps.fr/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"physical-product\",\n  \"score\": 6.8,\n  \"idea\": \"A single 3D watch is the only actor: it holds centre stage and turns, flips and finally explodes into parts while giant product-name letters slide behind and in front of it.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"clinical\",\n   \"metallic\",\n   \"monochrome\",\n   \"technical\",\n   \"quiet\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"product-object-centre\",\n  \"hero\": \"Light grey field with soft darker blurs toward the corners. A steel chronograph rendered in 3D stands upright at dead centre, about 80% of viewport height. Behind it the product name is set once across the full width in a wide, squared geometric sans at 24vw in mid-grey; the watch covers the middle character, so only two letters at the left edge and two at the right are readable. A thin circle about 700px across with faint radial spokes and one darker arc sits behind the watch like a dial diagram. No navigation, logo, body copy or button anywhere.\",\n  \"type\": \"Nekst, a wide squared geometric sans, regular weight, uppercase, used only huge (up to 25vw) in black, mid-grey and white within one line stack. Body is Inter at 12px in 130px columns, roughly a 30x jump with nothing in between.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#e8e8e8 #c7c7c7 #a1a1a1 #6b6b6b #0a0a0a #ffffff — Entirely greyscale: pale grey ground with out-of-focus darker clouds, type in black, grey and white. The page darkens to mid-grey for the exploded view. Only the brass gear train adds warmth.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"One real-time 3D steel watch shown front, three-quarter, caseback and exploded into dial, movement and plates lined up on a horizontal axis. No photographs; the object floats with no ground shadow.\",\n  \"layout\": \"No grid chrome at all: the object holds the centre while type moves around it. Giant letters crop at any edge, captions sit in a 130px column left or right of the watch, and one product label is rotated 90 degrees.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"showcase\",\n    \"description\": \"Four stacked lines of uppercase display type about 110px tall, flush left at mid-page and running off the right edge: line one mid-grey, line two black, lines three and four pale grey to white. The watch, tilted three-quarter, floats over the upper right of the stack and hides parts of letters, so type and object share the same space instead of sitting side by side.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"features\",\n    \"description\": \"The watch is turned to show its open caseback, placed just left of centre. To its right, a 130px-wide column holds two micro-paragraphs at 12px, each with a grey one-line title above. A small grey circular toggle sits far left. A white display word crops off the top edge. The rest of the frame is empty grey with a darker blurred cloud at upper right.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"Exploded view. The ground shifts to a mid-grey vertical gradient with a faint horizon line. The watch's components (dial, tourbillon, movement, barrel, bridges) are separated and spaced along one horizontal axis at eye level like specimens. Tiny part names are set vertically along the bottom edge under each piece; a small prompt with a plus icon sits top-centre.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Set the product name so large that the product itself replaces one of its characters, leaving the name half-hidden and the object as the missing letter.\",\n   \"Stack one display line in three tints (black, mid-grey, white) on a grey ground so a single typeface produces depth without colour.\",\n   \"End a product story with an exploded view laid out on one horizontal axis with vertical micro-labels instead of a spec table.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-justin-lerner\",\n  \"name\": \"Justin Lerner\",\n  \"url\": \"https://jlern.com\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"personal-portfolio\",\n  \"score\": 6.8,\n  \"idea\": \"The portfolio is a hairline grid of square cells in which the letters of the owner's name are scattered among small animated project emblems, so name and work form one crossword-like board.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"playful\",\n   \"spare\",\n   \"witty\",\n   \"hand-made\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"grid-index\",\n  \"hero\": \"White page divided by pale grey hairlines into five columns of exact squares (each 20vw), so three full rows and a sliver of a fourth show. No header, navigation or text block. Each cell holds one centred object about half the cell wide: either a single black slab-serif capital at 5.6vw (one in the top-left cell, one top-right, three more scattered through rows two and three) or a small project emblem such as a pixel speech bubble, a photographed bowl, a red robot arm, a wireframe figure, a logo badge or a line-drawn building. One cell holds only a soft blurred cloud. About 90% of the area is white.\",\n  \"type\": \"Museo Slab is the only face on desktop: weight-500 capitals at 80px used as grid letters, with no body copy at all (eleven words on the page). Mobile adds light italic slab project names and small sans year tabs.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#ffffff #e9eae8 #111111 #fff200 #f0563a #4fd0c8 — White ground, grey hairlines, black letters. Colour arrives only in the emblems, each in its own one- or two-colour scheme (yellow, coral, teal, purple). Mobile adds two solid yellow icon tiles.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Small spot illustrations and logos in deliberately mixed styles (pixel art, line drawing, isometric, wireframe mesh, one cut-out photo), each centred in a square cell with no frame or background, and animated.\",\n  \"layout\": \"A single edge-to-edge grid of 20vw squares with hairline dividers and no outer margin; the whole site is about 1.3 screens. Mobile switches to two columns and adds a year tab in each cell's top-right corner and an italic name under each emblem.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"work\",\n    \"description\": \"The grid continues for one more row below the fold with five cells holding only emblems. Across frames the emblems are caught in different states: a logo badge collapsing to a small monogram, a scan line moving down the wireframe figure, a pencil travelling across a drawn face, a coin appearing and disappearing. Each cell is a tiny looping or hover-driven animation, with no captions on desktop.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"other\",\n    \"description\": \"Mobile header built from the same cells: a small square with the initial on crosshair lines at left, an empty cell, then two solid-yellow square tiles carrying a document icon and a paper-plane icon. A transparent header overlays the top: the parent group's logo at a 40px left margin, seven sans links spread along the right half, divided from the image by a one-pixel translucent rule. There is no scrim; the photo's warm mid-tones carry the white text. Mobile keeps the same arrangement with a hamburger.\",\n  \"type\": \"Domaine Text Light for the venue name, intro paragraphs, section titles and footer links, all modest (60px name, 28 to 40px elsewhere); Modern Gothic for navigation, labels and small print at 12 to 16px. No large display type anywhere: the scale is deliberately flat.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#f5f0ea #b9b1a4 #000000 #b5694d #ddd8d2 — Warm cream page, a taupe booking bar, black for the gift-card panel and footer. Colour comes from the photography: terracotta tile, pale timber and plant green.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Editorial interior and food photography in warm natural light, often with a motion-blurred figure. Full-bleed hero, then a horizontal strip of mixed-width crops, square social thumbnails and tall 4:5 venue portraits; corners almost square.\",\n  \"layout\": \"40px side margins with content hung from full-width hairlines. Directly below, a strip of photographs of unequal widths runs off the right edge, cropped by the viewport.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"cta\",\n    \"description\": \"A black rectangle inset 40px from the page edges and about 650px tall. Left of centre, a six-line serif paragraph in cream at about 30px with a tiny outlined pill button under it; at right, a single flat taupe rectangle the proportions of a bank card, about 235px wide, bearing the logo split to its two edges. Nothing else: the flat card stands in for an image.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"gallery\",\n    \"description\": \"A horizontal carousel of sibling venues: 4:5 portrait photographs about 440px wide with 20px gaps, three visible and a fourth peeking at the right edge. No navigation, logo, button or image; about 85% of the screen is empty colour. It works as a title card before the scroll sequence starts.\",\n  \"type\": \"Inria Serif regular for the opening title at 90px; PP Editorial New, light and slightly condensed, for the dark-green scroll lines at about 4vw; Sometype Mono in uppercase for the two corner labels and footer credits at about 12px. Warm throughout.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Flat vector illustration with black keylines in four colours: a cafe interior with red cabinet and lantern, shown first inside an outlined oval, then full-bleed; olive leaf sprigs cropped by the side edges; a botanical footer frieze with a dog.\",\n  \"layout\": \"One idea per screen across about 26 pinned screens. Two tiny mono labels fixed in the top corners are the only persistent chrome; everything else is centred type or a single illustration on a flat field with wide empty margins.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"intro\",\n    \"description\": \"Cream field. Large olive leaf sprigs enter from the left and right edges and are cropped by the viewport.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"gallery\",\n    \"description\": \"The oval scales up until the illustration fills the viewport edge to edge: a one-point-perspective room in flat brick, olive, mustard and cream with black outlines, a counter in the left foreground, a carved cabinet on the far wall and red shelving at the right edge. The two corner mono labels stay on top of the artwork; there is no other text.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"footer\",\n    \"description\": \"Pale cream field. A symmetrical band of sage-and-peach botanical illustration spans the full width across the middle third, with the small serif logo inside a vine cartouche centred above a tan dog. Two single-line mono credits in brick red sit at the bottom-left and bottom-right corners. No link columns, no rule, no background block.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Open with a chrome-free title card: one serif line, a rule exactly the title's width and a subtitle, centred on a flat saturated field.\",\n   \"Split a two-line statement diagonally on scroll, reveal an image in the gap, then scale that image's mask until it becomes the next full-bleed scene.\",\n   \"Hold illustration, type and backgrounds to the same four flat hues so each section change is a palette swap rather than a new style.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-lacoste-ace-breaker\",\n  \"name\": \"Lacoste Ace Breaker\",\n  \"url\": \"https://members-play.lacoste.com/ace-breaker-rg\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"other\",\n  \"score\": 6.8,\n  \"idea\": \"A branded arcade-game title screen where the game's own paddle and ball are set into the lockup like punctuation, over a dimmed 3D tennis court.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"sporty\",\n   \"premium\",\n   \"dark\",\n   \"playful\",\n   \"restrained\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"type-poster\",\n  \"hero\": \"Single fixed screen. A dimmed, slowly drifting 3D tennis court fills the viewport under a deep green wash. A two-line title is left-aligned 12.5% in from the left and sits just below centre: line one the brand name in a cream high-contrast serif, line two the game name in yellow wide grotesk at about 9.7vw, reaching 80% of the width. A tiny paddle-and-ball graphic fills the gap after line one. A hairline spans 75% of the width beneath; under it an outlined pill sits at the left end and a filled yellow pill with a ball icon at the right, with tiny uppercase legal text below. Logo top-left, hamburger top-right.\",\n  \"type\": \"Digest reports MonaSans throughout, weight 400, uppercase, zero tracking; the game name is 140px in a slightly wide cut. The brand line is drawn as a high-contrast serif wordmark at the same cap height. Three sizes only: title, 28–44px button labels, 11px legal.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#092617 #122815 #f4cf4e #efeadb #00503c — Everything lives inside one bottle-green field; cream for the brand line and outlines, a single warm yellow for the game name and primary button. No section changes.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"A real-time 3D tennis court with branded hoardings, pushed far back by a dark green overlay and fine grain so it reads as texture; a flat vector paddle and ball are the only bright objects.\",\n  \"layout\": \"One screen, no scroll. The content block is inset 12.5% each side and stacked in three bands: title, hairline, action row, with buttons pushed to opposite ends of the rule. On mobile the primary button is bracketed between two rules and right-aligned.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"cta\",\n    \"description\": \"The action row is the only other element: a hairline with slightly wobbly, hand-drawn edges, then two pills on one baseline at opposite ends. The secondary is a 2px cream outline about 255×95px with a pale label; the primary is a solid yellow capsule about 340×95px with a dark ball icon and dark label near 44px. Legal copy hangs under the secondary button, left-aligned, in bold 12px uppercase at reduced opacity.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Drop a small object from the product (here the game's paddle and ball) into the empty space at the end of a short headline line so the lockup itself carries the concept.\",\n   \"Set a two-line title with line one in a serif wordmark and line two in a wide grotesk at the same cap height, separated by colour rather than size.\",\n   \"Use a full 3D scene as wallpaper by burying it under a roughly 85–90% tint of the brand colour, so it adds depth without competing with type.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"aww-the-tie-break\",\n  \"name\": \"The Tie-break\",\n  \"url\": \"https://thetiebreak.merci-michel.com/\",\n  \"source\": \"Awwwards Site of the Day\",\n  \"kind\": \"other\",\n  \"score\": 6.8,\n  \"idea\": \"The start screen of a branded tennis game, where the lines of a court seen from above become the frame around the title; only this screen was captured.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"sporty\",\n   \"soft-focus\",\n   \"elegant\",\n   \"nostalgic\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"fullbleed-media-overlay\",\n  \"hero\": \"A heavily blurred, grainy photograph of a figure in a cream jacket on a blue court fills the viewport. Thin white-to-blue lines trace a tennis court in plan across the whole screen: two horizontals near the top, two near the bottom, an inner rectangle about 45% of the viewport wide, and centre ticks; every line stops short of the middle column to leave it clear. In that column, stacked and centred: two partner logos, a two-line italic serif title at 112px (7.8vw) broken at its hyphen, three lines of 12px sans, and a small white button with a ball icon inside a hairline outer frame.\",\n  \"type\": \"Instrument Serif italic at 112px for the title, white, sentence case with an exclamation mark; Work Sans 12px for the description and button label. Only two sizes, roughly a 9x jump, plus the stacked co-brand logos.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#335483 #284879 #d8ccbc #1e3a8c #ffffff #8a3b45 — Cool court blues dominate, with the blurred cream jacket as a warm mass behind the title and a hint of red at the lower edge; type, lines and button are white.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"One campaign photograph blurred until it is only colour masses and overlaid with coarse noise, used full-bleed as a field. On mobile the crop turns grey and darker with heavier grain.\",\n  \"layout\": \"Single screen. A centre column about 22% of the viewport wide holds all content; the rest is the blurred field ruled by court lines that run to every edge. No navigation, no footer.\",\n  \"sections\": [],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Draw the subject's own geometry, here court lines in plan, as hairlines across the full viewport and interrupt them where content sits.\",\n   \"Blur a campaign photo until it is only colour masses, add coarse grain, and use it as the background so white type stays readable.\",\n   \"Frame a small solid button with a second hairline outline a few pixels outside it.\"\n  ]\n },\n {\n  \"id\": \"opl-lennys-newsletter-product-pass\",\n  \"name\": \"Lenny’s Newsletter Product Pass\",\n  \"url\": \"https://www.lennysproductpass.com\",\n  \"source\": \"One Page Love\",\n  \"kind\": \"other\",\n  \"score\": 6.8,\n  \"idea\": \"A perks membership presented as a conference lanyard badge, with every partner offer drawn as a tear-off coupon ticket.\",\n  \"mood\": [\n   \"friendly\",\n   \"warm\",\n   \"illustrated\",\n   \"promotional\"\n  ],\n  \"archetype\": \"split-text-media\",\n  \"hero\": \"Peach field. A floating pill navigation bar about 72% of the viewport wide sits 40px from the top: script wordmark with campfire mascot at left, three links and an orange outlined pill button at right. Below, a two-column split. The left 45% holds a three-line bold sans headline at about 2.8vw, a three-line paragraph, then a wide white email pill with thick black outline and an orange arrow button inside its right end. On the right, two illustrated badge cards hang on orange lanyard straps that run off the top edge behind the nav, tilted against each other. A tan logo marquee runs edge to edge along the bottom.\",\n  \"type\": \"Degular in bold for headings and regular for body, sentence case, no tracking; hero headline about 40px against 20px body, section titles 64px and centred. A brush-script wordmark and a hand-lettered marker face (faveHandPro) on each coupon's value label supply the personality.\",\n  \"colour\": \"#fff1e8 #fdd4b5 #ffffff #f6871f #111111 #d9a67e — Everything lives in one orange family: pale peach page, deeper peach panels, saturated orange only on buttons and lanyards, black outlines for structure. Partner logos keep their own colours inside white cards.\",\n  \"imagery\": \"Flat vector illustration with thick black outlines: lanyard badges, campfire mascot, yellow starburst stickers. Otherwise third-party logos, tan-tinted in the marquee and full colour inside cards. No photography.\",\n  \"layout\": \"The hero is a left-anchored split; everything after is a centred heading over a three-column grid of identical coupon cards repeated for about seven screens, the first group wrapped in a wide rounded peach panel. The closing panel returns to a split.\",\n  \"sections\": [\n   {\n    \"role\": \"showcase\",\n    \"description\": \"Three-column grid of coupon cards, white with a 2px black outline and 14px radius. Each card stacks: partner logo top-left, one bold line stating the offer, two or three lines of grey description, then a dotted perforation line and a peach stub with a hand-lettered dollar value at left and a small claim link at right. Some cards carry a yellow starburst sticker rotated over the top-right corner, breaking the outline.\"\n   },\n   {\n    \"role\": \"cta\",\n    \"description\": \"A wide peach panel with black outline and large radius, inset from the page edges. Left half: two-line bold heading, short paragraph, orange outlined pill button. Right half: a single column of partner logos stacked vertically and clipped by the panel's top and bottom edges, reading as a vertical ticker. Below the panel the footer is one row: script wordmark left, four links and the pill button right.\"\n   }\n  ],\n  \"steal\": [\n   \"Draw each offer as a physical coupon with a dotted perforation line, a tinted stub and a hand-lettered value, so a long grid of logos reads as tickets instead of cards.\",\n   \"Hang the hero illustration from the top edge of the viewport and pass it behind the floating nav so the page seems to continue above the screen.\",\n   \"Tint all partner logos in one brand-derived tan for the marquee and save their full colour for the cards where they matter.\"\n  ]\n }\n]",

  "bundled-skills/design-taste-frontend/evals/evals.json": "{\n  \"skill_name\": \"design-taste-frontend\",\n  \"how_to_run\": \"For each eval, give the prompt to a fresh agent that has this skill, and to a second fresh agent without it (the baseline). Render both with scripts/inspect.mjs and have a judge who does not know which is which score the screenshots with references/critique.md. Record inspector FAIL counts for both.\",\n  \"evals\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": 1,\n      \"name\": \"saas-invoicing\",\n      \"prompt\": \"Build a landing page for Ledgerly, an invoicing tool for freelance designers. What it does: you write an invoice in under a minute, the client pays by card or bank transfer, and it sends polite reminders by itself when an invoice is overdue. It costs 9 euros a month flat, with a 14-day free trial and no card needed. Include pricing and a short FAQ. There is no existing brand and no screenshots; the product name is all we have. Plain static HTML, CSS and JS in one folder.\",\n      \"expected_output\": \"A static landing page with a clear idea drawn from invoicing itself, headlines of two lines or fewer at 1440/768/390, no eyebrow labels, no monospace, no index numbering, no thin rules, no gradients or shadows, a non-default palette and type system, a pricing section that is not three cards, and no invented customers or statistics.\",\n      \"files\": []\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": 2,\n      \"name\": \"restaurant-osteria\",\n      \"prompt\": \"Make a one-page website for Osteria Nove, a 38-seat Italian restaurant in Alfama, Lisbon. Handmade pasta, a short natural wine list, dinner only, Tuesday to Saturday from 19:00. Address: Rua dos Remédios 9. Reservations by phone (+351 21 000 0009) or email (mesa@osterianove.pt). The page needs the menu (invent a believable short one: antipasti, pasta, dolci, with prices in euros), hours, address and how to book. We have no photographs yet. Static HTML/CSS/JS.\",\n      \"expected_output\": \"A one-page restaurant site with a specific idea (for example the page as the menu itself), the menu set typographically without divider lines, practical information easy to find, bundled photographs used only as atmosphere and listed for replacement, and all house rules met.\",\n      \"files\": []\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": 3,\n      \"name\": \"portfolio-designer\",\n      \"prompt\": \"I'm Mara Lindqvist, a product designer in Stockholm with eight years in fintech and health apps. I need a portfolio homepage: six selected projects (make up plausible names, clients, years and one-line descriptions), a short about paragraph, and a way to contact me (mara@lindqvist.studio). I don't have project images ready, so design it so it still looks finished without them, or use placeholders that I can swap. Static HTML/CSS/JS.\",\n      \"expected_output\": \"A portfolio page that looks finished without project imagery (a typographic index, a name-led hero, or atmosphere photographs clearly marked for replacement), with a designed footer, a phone layout that is its own composition, and all house rules met.\",\n      \"files\": []\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": 4,\n      \"name\": \"product-ceramics\",\n      \"prompt\": \"Launch page for Kiln, a ceramic pour-over coffee set (dripper, carafe and two cups) that is hand-glazed in small batches in Porto. It costs 84 euros and ships across the EU within a week. The glaze is mixed by hand so no two sets are identical. We have not shot product photos yet, so there are no images of the set. One page, with a way to buy (a button is enough). Static HTML/CSS/JS.\",\n      \"expected_output\": \"A product page that does not fake product photography: it either commits to type and colour, uses one shape from the object as a motif, or uses atmosphere photographs honestly, with the price and purchase action clear, and all house rules met.\",\n      \"files\": []\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": 5,\n      \"name\": \"guesthouse-ericeira\",\n      \"prompt\": \"Website for Casa Mirante, a six-room guesthouse on the cliffs above Ericeira, Portugal. Rooms from 140 euros a night with breakfast included; ten minutes' walk to the surf at Ribeira d'Ilhas; open March to November. One page: what it is, the rooms, what's nearby, and how to book (email reservas@casamirante.pt). We have no photographs yet. Static HTML/CSS/JS.\",\n      \"expected_output\": \"A calm, photograph-led or type-led one-pager whose hero is one clear thing, with rooms and booking information easy to find, bundled coast photographs used as atmosphere and listed for replacement, and all house rules met.\",\n      \"files\": []\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": 6,\n      \"name\": \"conference-format\",\n      \"prompt\": \"Landing page for Format, a two-day design conference in Rotterdam on 14 and 15 May 2027. Twelve speakers (invent plausible names and talk titles), 400 seats, tickets at 390 euros, venue: Maassilo. Sections: what it is, the line-up, the schedule in brief, tickets, and a short FAQ. No brand exists yet beyond the name. Static HTML/CSS/JS.\",\n      \"expected_output\": \"An event page with a strong typographic or colour idea, the line-up and schedule set as structured text without divider lines or index numbers, a ticket section that is not three cards, and all house rules met.\",\n      \"files\": []\n    }\n  ]\n}\n",
  "bundled-skills/design-taste-frontend/assets/base.css": "/* tasteskill / base.css\n   A neutral foundation: reset, token names, fluid type steps, a 12-column grid, states and the motion\n   helpers from references/motion.md. It has no look of its own. Copy it into the project, replace the\n   token values with the ones on the direction sheet, and build on top. Delete what you do not use. */\n\n/* ---------- tokens (replace with the dealt palette and type system) ---------- */\n:root {\n  --bg: #ffffff;\n  --surface: #f2f2f2;\n  --ink: #111111;\n  --muted: #5c5c5c;\n  --accent: #111111;\n  --accent-ink: #ffffff;\n\n  --font-display: system-ui, sans-serif;\n  --font-text: system-ui, sans-serif;\n\n  --step-small: clamp(0.8125rem, 0.79rem + 0.1vw, 0.875rem);\n  --step-body: clamp(1.0625rem, 1rem + 0.25vw, 1.1875rem);\n  --step-lead: clamp(1.25rem, 1.1rem + 0.7vw, 1.625rem);\n  --step-head: clamp(2rem, 1.3rem + 3.2vw, 4rem);\n  --step-display: clamp(3rem, 1rem + 9vw, 9rem); /* set from the hero blueprint */\n\n  --margin: clamp(1rem, 2.2vw, 2rem);    /* page side margin: tight, so content reaches the edges */\n  --gutter: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);      /* column gap */\n  --section: clamp(5rem, 12vw, 13rem);   /* space between sections */\n  --radius: 0px;                          /* one radius for the whole page: 0, or large, decided once */\n\n  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);\n  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1);\n  --ease-soft: cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1);\n  --t-press: 140ms;\n  --t-hover: 180ms;\n  --t-ui: 240ms;\n  --t-reveal: 800ms;\n}\n\n/* ---------- reset ---------- */\n*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }\nhtml { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; text-size-adjust: 100%; scroll-behavior: auto; }\nbody { margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-text); font-size: var(--step-body); line-height: 1.5; font-kerning: normal; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; }\nh1, h2, h3, h4, p, figure, blockquote, ul, ol, dl, dd { margin: 0; }\nul[class], ol[class] { padding: 0; list-style: none; }\nimg, video, svg, canvas { display: block; max-width: 100%; }\nimg, video { height: auto; background: var(--surface); }\nbutton, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; color: inherit; }\nbutton { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; }\na { color: inherit; }\n:target { scroll-margin-top: 6rem; }\n::selection { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }\n:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }\n\n/* ---------- type ---------- */\nh1, h2, h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: inherit; text-wrap: balance; hyphens: none; }\n.display { font-size: var(--step-display); line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.035em; }\n.head { font-size: var(--step-head); line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.025em; }\n.lead { font-size: var(--step-lead); line-height: 1.35; max-width: 40ch; }\n.small { font-size: var(--step-small); line-height: 1.45; }\n.muted { color: var(--muted); }\np { max-width: 62ch; text-wrap: pretty; }\np + p { margin-top: 0.9em; }\n.nums { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\n.only-wide { display: none; }\n@media (min-width: 48em) { .only-wide { display: inline; } }\n\n/* ---------- layout ---------- */\n.wrap { padding-inline: var(--margin); }\n.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); column-gap: var(--gutter); }\n.section { padding-block: calc(var(--section) / 2); }\n.section + .section { margin-top: 0; }\n.bleed { margin-inline: calc(var(--margin) * -1); }\n.cover { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }\n.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; }\n\n/* ---------- controls ---------- */\n.button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.4rem; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); border-radius: var(--radius); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: transform var(--t-press) var(--ease-out), background-color var(--t-hover) ease, color var(--t-hover) ease; }\n.button:active { transform: scale(0.97); }\n.link { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: transparent; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; text-decoration-thickness: 0.07em; transition: text-decoration-color var(--t-hover) ease; }\n.link-plain { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; text-decoration-thickness: 0.07em; }\n@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {\n  .link:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }\n}\n.field { width: 100%; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem; background: var(--surface); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius); font-size: max(1rem, var(--step-body)); }\n\n/* ---------- motion helpers (content stays visible without JavaScript) ---------- */\n.lines .line { display: block; overflow: hidden; padding-bottom: 0.08em; margin-bottom: -0.08em; }\n.lines [data-line] { display: block; }\n.shutter { overflow: hidden; }\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {\n  .js [data-rise] { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px); animation: ad-rise var(--t-reveal) var(--ease-out) forwards; animation-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 90ms + 120ms); }\n  .js .lines [data-line] { transform: translateY(105%); animation: ad-line 900ms var(--ease-out) forwards; animation-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 110ms + 150ms); }\n  .js [data-reveal] { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); transition: opacity 700ms var(--ease-out), transform 900ms var(--ease-out); }\n  .js [data-reveal].is-in { opacity: 1; transform: none; }\n  .js .shutter[data-reveal] { opacity: 1; transform: none; clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); transition: clip-path 1100ms var(--ease-in-out); }\n  .js .shutter[data-reveal] img { transform: scale(1.12); transition: transform 1500ms var(--ease-soft); }\n  .js .shutter[data-reveal].is-in { clip-path: inset(0); }\n  .js .shutter[data-reveal].is-in img { transform: none; }\n}\n@keyframes ad-rise { to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }\n@keyframes ad-line { to { transform: none; } }\n",
  "bundled-skills/design-taste-frontend/assets/base.js": "// tasteskill / base.js — the small amount of script the motion helpers in base.css need.\n// Put this line in <head> so the hidden states only apply when scripting works:\n//   <script>document.documentElement.classList.add('js')</script>\n// Then load this file at the end of <body> (or with defer).\n\n// Reveal once when an element enters the viewport. Never replays, never leaves content hidden.\n(() => {\n  const targets = document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]');\n  if (!targets.length) return;\n  if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) { targets.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('is-in')); return; }\n  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n    for (const entry of entries) {\n      if (!entry.isIntersecting) continue;\n      entry.target.classList.add('is-in');\n      io.unobserve(entry.target);\n    }\n  }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -12% 0px', threshold: 0.1 });\n  targets.forEach((el) => io.observe(el));\n  // safety net: if anything is still hidden a few seconds after load (observer never fired), show it\n  window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(() => {\n    targets.forEach((el) => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.top < innerHeight && r.bottom > 0) el.classList.add('is-in'); });\n  }, 2500));\n})();\n\n// Optional, for \"colour by chapter\": each chapter paints its own full-bleed ground in CSS\n// (style=\"background: var(--field-2); color: var(--field-2-ink)\"), so the colour changes exactly at\n// section edges. This only lets a fixed header take the ink of the chapter under it. Give each chapter\n// data-ink=\"#hex\" and style the header with color: var(--header-ink, var(--ink)).\n// Never recolour the whole page from an observer: mid-change, a paragraph sits on two colours.\n(() => {\n  const chapters = document.querySelectorAll('[data-ink]');\n  if (!chapters.length || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;\n  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n    for (const entry of entries) if (entry.isIntersecting) document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--header-ink', entry.target.dataset.ink);\n  }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -92% 0px', threshold: 0 });\n  chapters.forEach((el) => io.observe(el));\n})();\n",
  "agents/openai.yaml": "interface:\n  display_name: \"成品工作台\"\n  short_description: \"打开上传界面，理解材料、澄清关键思路，由当前 AI 制作并交付成品文件\"\n  default_prompt: \"使用 $deliver-workbench，先立即打开成品工作台窗口，让我提交资料并在界面回答问题，在同一工作台完成追问后直接拿到成品。\"\ndependencies:\n  tools:\n    - type: \"mcp\"\n      value: \"delivery_workbench\"\n      description: \"在本机连接上传界面、任务材料、追问与成品下载的工作台服务\"\n",
